| | Peter, Individuals who are not U.S. citizens may soon be able to influence the outcome of the most significant election in recent history. The consequences of this scenario would be nothing short of disastrous... In a shocking move, Arizona's Democratic Secretary of State has opened a perilous path for non-citizens, whether legal or not, to participate in the 2024 election. **This includes the pivotal Republican primary in March.**

---
[ **DONATE NOW TO FIGHT AGAINST IT**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=75a5f89c242f41c68cba9d91d36765fb&_e=3GvQ5YlRBT7RhIYiV40k_JKnSiS7IXysfjxlVGpTayKXP75FOsSFJeVynCI-fHfVbi8ggXEH1_vAx4ScwhyXqI_rx1n5sNshG81y9YWl-3g19PWu0B7v5GdT0C7IsdgduO6RqNfitGswvyEktZrsOaPvJ792ROzUIsk4RqDnTq6mw-y8YCk0XsDNQBcjfYBzISCAQKOIOHbr8X0lA0KqWSUTooqpbOXECMQhKF3PjKXMOXKCri40AY4jpHFJgA8wBbUZZ4-cpilTxn32Xeo_7U9P2hOgHL9GtNN7XIlZnVMVp66-uAWMrEGANBCDAYTs4fpIZTgZzOVFqTlDjy-MRFfEQhhE9s07PXe65lUfawpHTedo6lHUhJuStLSaIu8h)

Federal law explicitly forbids non-citizens from voting in federal elections, under threat of fines and imprisonment. However, Arizona's radical Secretary of State found a sneaky loophole.

Those who register using the federal voter registration form, distinct from the state forms we're familiar with, become "federal-only" voters. These voters can participate in federal races, like the March 2024 primary, without having their _U.S. citizenship verified by any state authorities._

**This issue transcends politics – it's about ensuring every vote cast in 2024 is legitimate. It's about protecting the sanctity of our elections.**

As the nation's premier organization dedicated to upholding the security of America's elections, we refuse to sit idly by while our electoral process is brought to its knees. **Only American citizens should be allowed to vote in American elections! **

We urgently need your support to prevent this from happening. By donating to our cause, you become a crucial part of this mission to safeguard our elections.

Despite serving in Congress for over a decade, Scott Perry has a disappointing record of voting against the interests of Central Pennsylvanians. **[If you're fed up with his sad excuse of "leadership," rush a donation of $10 or more to support Janelle's values and people-driven campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78083908/452331628/461865924?amount=10&source=SBD_JS_EM_FR_013024_2_6_EOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODViMzRkYjItY2JiZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=z-J43GIb0wb-akWfabNfVOw4xVBpICJar8D0NV-KjIA=)** **Let's look at Scott Perry's greatest hits in his voting record...**
* Voted _AGAINST_ the expulsion of fellow liar George Santos
* Voted _AGAINST_ the same-sex-marriage-inclusive Respect for Marriage Act
* Voted _AGAINST_ the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law
* Voted _FOR_ the transphobic Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act
* Voted _FOR_ two egregiously anti-choice bills just two weeks ago...

It's apparently not enough for Scott Perry to attempt to overturn the results of the 2020 election. body:
| | Peter – I want to share some of my lived experiences and how they have shaped my decision to run for TX-32. This email is different from what I usually send, but you deserve to know why I am driven to run for Congress — **[however, if you want to go ahead and make a donation to my campaign, you can do so now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78084498/452334663/-1417367329?refcode=em24_240130_EOM5PM_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240130_EOM5PM_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=2cd086fa-cbbf-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmNkMDg2ZmEtY2JiZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=etZJB1Y5dGhSRbzc_czMJZH46gzyTPlT5r0Yo1sURwY=)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78084499/452334664/-1417367329?refcode=em24_240130_EOM5PM_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240130_EOM5PM_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=2cd086fa-cbbf-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmNkMDg2ZmEtY2JiZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=etZJB1Y5dGhSRbzc_czMJZH46gzyTPlT5r0Yo1sURwY=) Growing up, I watched with pride as my father put on his Air Force uniform each day. Living on military bases around the world — from Albuquerque to Okinawa (and a _hardship_ tour in Hawaii) — I grew up surrounded by people of all racial, ethnic, and religious backgrounds. My parents always modeled inclusion and celebrated the diversity around us.

But there came a point where I learned the power of being a Black man — the good and the bad.

I still have a visceral reaction thinking about the dehumanizing moment I was first called a racial slur as a third-grade kid trying to join a pickup baseball game. A moment that made clear I’d always have to work harder, be better, and never quit. That determination led me to follow my father’s example of military service, and I earned a congressional appointment to the United States Air Force Academy – the first in my family to go to college.

**Service before self is an ethos I internalized during my time at the Academy — knowing that with a mindset of serving the greater good, we can create a better world.**

My record of service did not end as an Air Force officer. I answered another call to serve in medicine. It is there I learned another disheartening reality about representation. Few Black professors, few Black doctors, and few Black medical students. Even today, there are fewer Black men entering medical school than in the 1970s.

A mentor told me, “If you can’t see it, you can’t be it.” Well, I followed a path to be seen – by those inspired to choose a career in medicine and by my patients. Yet, there were times patients asked me to clear their food trays, empty the trash, or flat out refused to accept my care – even though I was their doctor. At times I felt insulted and angry, but I knew my presence represented something bigger than myself. So, I committed myself to excellence and service.

I chose to work in safety-net hospitals so I would have a career serving the underserved. The majority of my patients were from communities of color, and I lost count of the number of times Black patients told me I was the first Black doctor they ever had.

Since moving to Dallas in 2010, I’ve served on the frontlines of our healthcare crisis as a trauma surgeon at Parkland Hospital and on the faculty at UT Southwestern Medical Center. Working to increase diverse representation in medicine while addressing the persistent racial disparities in access to affordable healthcare inspired much of my work. And there is much more work to do. My wife and I are raising our daughter here, and I have a unique perspective on the issues our community is facing – as a husband, father, doctor, and a Black man.

Ours is a majority-minority district, and for those who feel excluded from the political process, diverse representation is crucial to ensure the values, experiences, and needs of _all_ are honored. Once elected, I will be that type of leader and fight for you as hard as I’d fight for my own family. I will fight for TX-32.

But I can only do that with your support. I said it once at the debate, and I'll say it again: **your endorsement is the only way we can win this race.**

clean_body: | | Peter – I want to share some of my lived experiences and how they have shaped my decision to run for TX-32. This email is different from what I usually send, but you deserve to know why I am driven to run for Congress — = = Growing up, I watched with pride as my father put on his Air Force uniform each day. Living on military bases around the world — from Albuquerque to Okinawa (and a hardship tour in Hawaii) — I grew up surrounded by people of all racial, ethnic, and religious backgrounds. My parents always modeled inclusion and celebrated the diversity around us. But there came a point where I learned the power of being a Black man — the good and the bad. I still have a visceral reaction thinking about the dehumanizing moment I was first called a racial slur as a third-grade kid trying to join a pickup baseball game. A moment that made clear I’d always have to work harder, be better, and never quit. That determination led me to follow my father’s example of military service, and I earned a congressional appointment to the United States Air Force Academy – the first in my family to go to college. Service before self is an ethos I internalized during my time at the Academy — knowing that with a mindset of serving the greater good, we can create a better world. My record of service did not end as an Air Force officer. I answered another call to serve in medicine. It is there I learned another disheartening reality about representation. Few Black professors, few Black doctors, and few Black medical students. Even today, there are fewer Black men entering medical school than in the 1970s. A mentor told me, “If you can’t see it, you can’t be it.” Well, I followed a path to be seen – by those inspired to choose a career in medicine and by my patients. Yet, there were times patients asked me to clear their food trays, empty the trash, or flat out refused to accept my care – even though I was their doctor. At times I felt insulted and angry, but I knew my presence represented something bigger than myself. So, I committed myself to excellence and service. I chose to work in safety-net hospitals so I would have a career serving the underserved. The majority of my patients were from communities of color, and I lost count of the number of times Black patients told me I was the first Black doctor they ever had. Since moving to Dallas in 2010, I’ve served on the frontlines of our healthcare crisis as a trauma surgeon at Parkland Hospital and on the faculty at UT Southwestern Medical Center. Working to increase diverse representation in medicine while addressing the persistent racial disparities in access to affordable healthcare inspired much of my work. And there is much more work to do. My wife and I are raising our daughter here, and I have a unique perspective on the issues our community is facing – as a husband, father, doctor, and a Black man. Ours is a majority-minority district, and for those who feel excluded from the political process, diverse representation is crucial to ensure the values, experiences, and needs of all are honored. Once elected, I will be that type of leader and fight for you as hard as I’d fight for my own family. I will fight for TX-32. But I can only do that with your support. New POLITICO reporting has detailed how these groups advise leveraging new rules at agencies like the FTC, FDA, and EPA, as well as using executive orders to slash abortion access nationwide — without needing to receive Congressional approval. This month, Congress introduced a bipartisan tax framework that would expand the Child Tax Credit (CTC) to benefit sixteen million kids.
When Congress expanded the Child Tax Credit in 2021, we cut the child poverty rate almost in half. Ninety percent of kids in Colorado benefitted. It was a huge success.
Despite Michael’s best efforts, Congress let the expanded Child Tax Credit expire in 2022. He’s been working hard to get it reinstated ever since.

But with hours to go, we’re still $10,840 short of our goal, so I have to ask: = Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = With your help, we drove Lauren Boebert out of the district. But this race is going to be even harder not running against her. It’s time that the people of Western and Southern Colorado had a representative in Washington working to get things done for them – not taking money from corporate PAC donors and pushing wild conspiracy theories. My campaign is funded entirely by donors, like you, giving an average of just $22 online this month. A people-powered campaign is what will help us fight back against the Super PAC lies – but I’m counting on your support now if we’re going to be successful. We only lost by 546 votes in 2022. It was the closest race in the country, even though no one gave us a chance. We are so close to hitting our end-of-January fundraising goal, but time is running out before the deadline. = This is our most important fundraising goal of the campaign so far. Let’s start 2024 strong. I couldn’t do this without you. Thank you so much for joining me on this journey again. With gratitude - Adam ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. Let's keep in mind, the political elite has gotten nothing done for us to stop the wasteful spending, to secure the border, or to keep us safe as we see wars happening around the world. That is exactly what we DO NOT want. The reason the political elite and members of Congress are upset that I'm still in this race is because I'm going against their agenda that is failing the American people. I've pushed for term limits, I've pushed for mental competency tests, and I've said that if they don't get a budget out on time, they shouldn't get paid. I have fought against the political class my entire life. You know why? I will always choose to fight for YOU rather than our elected officials in DC. | I've never been concerned with what the political elite wants--I 'm concerned with what hardworking American families want... ...Getting inflation under control, getting our kids reading again, securing the border, and bringing law and order back to this country. Supporters are FLOODING to our movement because voters don't want a coronation. They want an election! They want a choice to move on from the drama and chaos. And they want a choice to elect a new generational leader this election--a leader who is going to work for them and offer the solutions our country is looking for! With you by my side, we will FIGHT to save the future of our great nation. Let's do this! My very best, Nikki R. | We’re in the homestretch. Ballots will be in the mail, and early voting locations across California will be open this time next week.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=5251%2E5257348%2EFZ-FvB)
“** _Shifty_**.”“A **terrible** guy.”“A _dishonest_ guy.”

Our end of month deadline is Wednesday, January 31st at midnight, and **here’s what will happen if we hit it:**
* We can ramp up our digital ads and reach voters in every part and pocket of the state.

name: Chuck Hubbard
subject: I’m the Democrat running against Virginia Foxx
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Pleased to meet you, my name is Chuck Hubbard and I'm running to unseat MAGA Republican Virginia Foxx.
| Hey there,

If we haven’t met before, I’m Chuck Hubbard. I’m a native of northwestern North Carolina who's spent forty years of my career working in local journalism, and I'm also the Democrat running for Congress to unseat Virginia Foxx.

(You may remember her from **when she screamed at a reporter to shut up last year.** As a former journalist myself, I took that one personally.)

These mountains have been my home all my life. I've spent most of my adult life working at the local paper my granddaddy built, and I always put my community first—and that's exactly why I decided to take a leap and run for this seat. I’m proud to say that I never once let my political beliefs influence my reporting. In Congress, I’ll take that same mindset, rejecting political theater and focusing on what’s important—improving the lives of the folks back home.

**But I’m also running because my opponent, Virginia Foxx, is one of the most dangerous Republicans you _may_ have never heard of.**

She’s an ultra-conservative Trump loyalist whose MAGA agenda is too extreme for North Carolina. As Chairwoman of the Committee on Education and the Workforce, she's been the Republican Party's main architect for dismantling public education and workers’ protections as we know it. I've watched her rise to power with a journalist's eye, and I've never once seen her put people before politics, or even before her own ambition.

I refuse to sit back and watch any longer as Virginia Foxx and Republicans in Congress ignore the needs of our neighbors, only focusing on their extremist social legislation and anti-worker policies. That’s not the North Carolina way, and we have a duty to stand up and fight it—and to stand up and fight for rural voters.

My campaign is going to every single county, and we’re going to do whatever we can to reach every single voter and make sure they know we care, we’re fighting for them, and we value their votes.

[**But I'll be honest: this isn't going to be easy. If we're going to stand a chance of winning, then I really need your support, friend. If you’re able to, please consider splitting a contribution of $10, $25 or anything you can between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project, in support of our campaign's effort to beat Virginia Foxx and flip this district blue.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/61067?t=6&akid=12713%2E878179%2ERSzvcj) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Chuck Hubbard and Voter Protection Project will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/61068?t=7&akid=12713%2E878179%2ERSzvcj)

If we stand together, we’ll have the resources to spread the Democratic message to every corner of my district—we’ll be able to fund a real campaign operation so that I can spend my time knocking on doors, turning out and talking with every Democrat and Unaffiliated voter I possibly can! I know it’s an uphill fight, friend, but I never met anybody who climbed a mountain by not trying.

Thanks for standing with me,
**Chuck Hubbard**

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: Pennsylvania is falling behind. . .
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Time is running out, and I still need to see 137 responses from pro-lifers like you in Pennsylvania!

In recent days, I’ve been asking top Students for Life Action supporters across the nation to complete their Students for Life Action Supporter Ballot to help me know how to direct our limited resources in 2024.

As it stands, Pennsylvania is falling behind.

So, can I count on you to be one of the 137 supporters we need from Pennsylvania [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240130]?

The way I see it, Pro-Life Friend, I have three programs I might have to cut if Students for Life Action doesn’t pick up the resources we’ll need to carry on through the end of 2024:

1. Young Voter Outreach – Our programs reaching out to young voters could not be more crucial as we move closer to the elections this fall, as they will be the future of the Pro-Life Movement.

But, if you think we should pull back on our efforts to tell young people the TRUTH about abortion in Pennsylvania, then mark: " STOP TURNING YOUNG PEOPLE AGAINST ABORTION [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240130]" on your Supporter Ballot.

2. State Legislative Battles – Pro-abortion legislation, including radical pro-abortion state referendums, are intentionally written with ambiguous language to confuse voters and allow legislators to define them in a way that permits abortions throughout all nine months of a pregnancy and forces taxpayers to pay for abortions.

If you think we should ease up on our fight against the Abortion Lobby in states like Pennsylvania, including our fight against radical abortion referendums, then mark: " STOP FIGHTING STATE BATTLES [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240130]" on your Supporter Ballot.

3. Vote Pro-Life First – This campaign is designed to help pro-abortion Democrat politicians and cowardly Republicans “retire early” by getting voters in their districts to know that ending the violence of abortion should be their #1 priority when it comes time to cast their vote.

Though, if you want me to dial it back and let the pro-abortion politicians in Pennsylvania remain in office just give me the word by marking: " STOP YOUR VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST CAMPAIGN [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240130]" on your Supporter Ballot.

4. DON’T CUT ANY PROGRAMS! – I want nothing more than to keep my foot on the gas pedal all the way through election day this November. . .but I won’t be able to do that without the generosity of good folks like you.

If you truly don’t want to see any cuts made, especially in Pennsylvania, then mark: " RAMP UP ALL OPERATIONS. GO ALL - IN [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240130]" on your Supporter Ballot and then follow that up with your most generous contribution right away!

Of course, you probably already know my preferred choice, especially with everything that’s at stake right now. . . I want to WIN!

But I can’t bear to make such a big decision right now without hearing from 137 more supporters in Pennsylvania first.

So please, fill out your Students for Life Action Supporter Ballot right away [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240130]!

And, once you’ve filled it out, please agree to your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 [https://secure.studentsforlifeaction.org/ballotpage?src=hf&msgid=240130]!

Thanks for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

President, Students for Life Action

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

subject: I can’t believe we have this in common with China and North Korea
body:
Did you know the United States has a human rights issue in common with countries like China and North Korea?

| [ ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c682193%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UutvkuitS6vknzSnqhNquQ&sysid=1)

Fellow American,

Did you know the United States has a human rights issue in common with countries like China and North Korea?

**Becuase of the Biden Administration's commitment to the abortion industry, the United States is 1 of 7 countries in the world that allows abortion-on-demand.

**Abortion-on-demand is the ending of an unborn child's life and _ANY_ point of a woman's pregnancy. A baby, fully developed at 38-40 weeks, an be aborted should its mother detemine she does not want her child.

**This is an appalling tragedy happening in our country today and there are many abortionists willing to carry out this barbaric practice celebrated by Big Abortion.

**My heart breaks for the complete devastation and the utter devaluing of human life our own president and his administration is sworn to protect.

These abortion extremists have yet to name a single protection they would grant any unborn child and put it into law. In fact, they want to make abortion-on-demand the law of the land and write it into our own Constitution!

Babies in the womb are screaming in pain because they are being tortured to death and no one can hear them. They have no voice to cry out when they are viciously murdered.

**[We must cry out for them _now_.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c682194%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=932beZbUHLhRced1Ir%2fLBw&sysid=1) **

Stand with SBA Pro-Life America on the front lines in the fight for life and let the Biden Administration know you stand with the majority of Americans and do not support this deadly agenda. Join 72% of Americans who want pro-life protections for babies who can feel pain at 15 weeks in the womb.

Submit your name at the link below and put an end to abortion-on-demand in our country _today._
[SIGN YOUR NAME](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c682105%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5WZzF%2fMOpnKoOc3uqMKaZA&sysid=1)
| We must be the voice for the unborn because our president and his administration have proven they will not protect these innocent children.

| The Dolan Record on Education Matt Dolan is the candidate for U.S. Senate that has a proven record of expanding school choice and standing firmly against the creep of Critical Race Theory into Ohio classrooms.

* The 2023 State Budget authored by Matt Dolan achieved universal school choice in Ohio.

* Dolan voted to ban critical race theory from classrooms in Ohio.

* Dolan expanded EdChoice eligibility, allowing more Ohio students to utilize the program.

* Dolan fought to secure $550 million for Ohio's schools to be used for mental health services, after-school opportunities for at-risk students and health clinics for underserved areas.

* Dolan voted to give our schools flexibility in continuing blended learning options. The bill states schools must teach students in-person for a majority of the year but allows flexibility when it is not possible.

* Dolan co-sponsored a bill to include a financial literacy course as part of the state's high school curriculum.

* Dolan was named the 2021 Legislator of the Year by the Public Children Services Association of Ohio (PCSAO) for his leadership and commitment to children and families involved in the children services system.

* For his advocacy and support of children across Ohio, Dolan was awarded the Ohio Alliance of Boys & Girls Clubs Blue Door Award in 2020.

| [ ](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkT2P2zAMhn-NvMnQl2V78HCokaW4oujSUaAlxidEX5AU9O8XuaaZbyVfPuBD_n437-CDT-cPiLjdbDW1mQSmHUAP7zBROHLtPicjmFCUcSq54YPb3Go16AE3PjOtV7lMYvjY9Ky5VUyus2ROAShhNZ_0MotFrnbBwW8PDuOSs0VNSo_XWR-rYnbi1xmEZEQxCFj7eEMsNqezYmsVy_0I3kIabY5D2D56L43INyIuRFzAPjYc2wGl5uCvOOZ6EnH5NGgvBZoTdRghOSIv9x6NhVjAn4nI_aWZk3lmhH5kWr5Xi0TupeZW0HafzmcrovP3SOSOEXwgQkMpCMF4R-TOGV-I0AXsDU78VxMTX_Vz2ObUMXUi959v9Pu3X_T_XYa6ufLHh-Cbnoli5wP-qd2__qC_AQAA___PSpl4)
---
Fellow American,

Did you know the United States has a human rights issue in common with countries like China and North Korea?

**Becuase of the Biden Administration's commitment to the abortion industry, the United States is 1 of 7 countries in the world that allows abortion-on-demand.

** Abortion-on-demand is the ending of an unborn child's life and _ANY_ point of a woman's pregnancy. A baby, fully developed at 38-40 weeks, an be aborted should its mother detemine she does not want her child.

**This is an appalling tragedy happening in our country today and there are many abortionists willing to carry out this barbaric practice celebrated by Big Abortion.

** My heart breaks for the complete devastation and the utter devaluing of human life our own president and his administration is sworn to protect.

name: Shift WA
subject: FWD: FACTS
body:
Here's a chilling fact that provides the starkest contrast
between Republicans and the current majority.

Friends,

Washington Democrats have crossed
a line that we cannot ignore.

In a shocking move, Washington
Democrats introduced House Bill 2030, which would grant felons in
prison - including notorious serial killer Gary Ridgway - the
right to vote and serve on a jury. We are not making this up -
the bill's Far-Left sponsor admitted her criminals-first approach
would extend even to the Green River Killer.

And this is just one of the many
outrageous and out-of-touch bills Democrat legislators have
brought forward in the first month of the 2024 legislative
session.

This week, State House Democrats
passed House Bill 1589 as their next step in banning natural gas
in our state. If this bill passes the Senate, it would prohibit
gas companies, particularly Puget Sound Energy (PSE), from
connecting new natural gas lines to new construction. PSE would
also no longer be obligated to provide natural gas service to
existing customers. This is an unprecedented intrusion into our
everyday lives.

But perhaps most egregiously,
Democrats seem to have adopted a mantra during this legislative
session - "If you can't let them vote, then just let them out."
Since their goal of allowing serial killers to vote may be
slipping away, they've also introduced House Bill 2001, which
would mean sentence reductions for current prisoners, by ignoring
previous criminal activity that liberals no longer consider
criminal.

It's not too late to voice your
opposition to these bills. The first legislative deadline is
approaching on January 31st, and your support can help ensure
that bills like these are stopped. You can voice your opposition
by officially commenting against these bills here: HB2030,
HB1589, and HB2001.

Shift WA is the only online
outlet you can trust to bring you the latest news from Olympia,
exposing Democrats for their terrible policies. We are committed
to keeping you informed and empowered.

To continue our efforts, we need
your support. Please consider making a donation today. Every
contribution helps us fight against these outrageous bills and
hold our elected officials accountable.

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team

P.S. Your donation is crucial in
the fight against these out-of-touch bills. Please contribute
today to support our cause.

DONATE

Washington. If you would like to send this message to some of
your friends, you can click here to do so.

You can also stay up to date on
our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following
us on Facebook & Twitter.

## Judge Strips Musk of $56 Billion Pay Package
A Delaware judge struck down Elon Musk's $55.8 billion pay package at Tesla, ruling that the compensation process at the publicly traded company [was "deeply flawed."](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPrCAURn8NdtcAAvoKizeFxcubbbc0V7wqMwhGcFz__Wa23vb7kpOT83nv7-i8C_MHrtTmKfZos3tRL6ASIFWvirGdiCRVBbWi5qYWghteLK1Q9fBHD4NAFGgNmcrUjRoayXlTaa0K10ouFReVEFwbIcra6KpGri1NY2NVwxSn0eW4l4_oQl5o8ld80V7auBa-XXLeEqv-Mtkx2Z3nWa4pvD8mOwpwJCa7NQa6mOxsXDcMjt4b-RhgPdITEmgNg_PexQCZkkfY8IIN7RNngpT3wz5hjGeA4YLHMc7EZIc73G5ief3_-lfs7bidb0AyNVN8XtH5H738a6zvAAAA___yLmtM) Tesla stock dropped nearly 3% on the news. Musk's status as one of the world's richest men was tied to his stock holdings at Tesla, and it's unclear how Tesla's board now plans to compensate Musk. The vesting structure of the pay package, the largest in public corporate history, was [meant to keep him focused on Tesla](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuO6yAQgOGnwR3WML6RguI07nLaLa1ZPGASfBHgWHn7Vbbe-m8-_V_36U4hhs3_p5VNcftEtoQXT0o2SmI7tdVsHDNyU7FRA_SDUtBDtRgNGnDWt9sNsSVoLH932jLarlOdRlUFg4AtqEYp6Hql6qHvmoGgs-xmbVstWuA5lD3Vjz1sZWEX3_uLU233tYpmKeXIovkncBQ4XtdVJz4Lp_zpAsfInqLA8XHOnmU6I2fp6LUneUQKWwnOZWkXipE3HzYv1zM_syycI8mD3vIg-yTP8sOUoGQDAscqmfm4Qowh94Nowa8U4q-o_PnnJwAA___DG2aO). The judge's ruling was in response to a stockholder lawsuit filed five years ago claiming Musk worked out his compensation with friends on the company's board. His lawyers argued that the [performance targets in the package](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL_uozAQhJ_GdIu8xoakoLgU6IrLtVeixSzgxH8QmKC8_Smpf-3MaPTp-3fv7-S8i_NfCtzmKfVks3txj1AhKN3rYmwnZsVVwS02sm4QZS2LpR0kjo3G64UqstUwjFdLGgejpskMVzUUrlVSaYkVojQ1YtnUpmpIGsvTeLH6IrTk0eW0lY_kYl548u_04q20KRS-XXJed1H9EqoTqjvPswx7_HRCdRzh2IXqQor8FqqzKawUHX8y9ilCOPYnWIoxZXgyr5B59wQrvWEl-6SZ4UxbXiCkjSEvFMEYGJz3LkV4HOPMsB3-e0gb3G64vH7_McXWjuv5We11I7ScAzn_5c0_2vsfAAD__8I6crw) were considered almost unreachable. Musk can appeal, but he had this to say for now: _" Never incorporate your company in the state of Delaware."_
## Biden Says He's Decided on Iran Response
[President Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2OqzAQQOGnMZ3RjH8wKVzcxl1uuyVy7CGZrMEIvEH79qtsvf2RPul8XKdr5MLr_X9cyLe5TjE1ftGEUqNUZjJd9jORIt2RRweDQ4QBuoefbUaVIugxG7Jkbtbly3hx8eJgxht17BUoA6gRwQ6IvRusdhFsojmPyYzCAGVude-fldf2oLl81xftfapLV_yjte0Q-p9QQahwnme_1cKNU30HQoWVzkOo8FaECoBCBQ1ChRtnWuXXIXc6troeJJ91z3GVsbWYPiUA6tEa1-0-byeXwsfghIH7Ern84u3PFT8BAAD__yDCXUo) told reporters he's decided how the U.S. will respond to the deadly drone strike that killed three American soldiers in Jordan, but he didn't offer any details. U.S. officials indicated the response could occur as soon as this week and hit multiple targets. National Security Council spokesperson [John Kirby](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LtyszAUBOCnEd1hdOPiguJ3QfU7bUpGcA6gREiMJFvjt8-QOtVXbLE7-_mYHsY667cPc9CQ1zCZJdsXTQKUAKknXeGwEklSFQ2i420nBG95tQ-3pse5p4463WKPBnWrZiUVzXjr51tf2UFyqblQQvCmFaLu2kZ1hjcLrdgvumeaE9ocYv0VrM87re4dXhTrJRyVG_acz8TUPyZHJsdSSn0kf2VMjuThmZgcPZWLEqJDJsfZInlYzWL9BlsM5fKMlNIzEgQPkdIZfCLIAWw0Hq4-QDLo3oAxeAKTs1m-mRxNhPtd7E8T_ldxwLNY52xqO6b5dhjrfmfmP0_7CQAA__-3anAV) said the administration wanted to avoid war with Iran, but the attack couldn't stand unanswered. There have been more than [150 attacks on U.S. personnel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fy6yAQAL8GddLcHQj0CorX0DltSs0ZTjYOFh6JWMnfZ5w69c7szr6f5hPnktfLG9_Ft6XOHFt-yoy9xp7MbLrkFxES3YlHB9YhgoXu6hPDEnGKQOzsmJhRn9H-YwM8sUzUZU9ABlAjwmgRB2dH7RjGKEuaopmUAUm51W241by2qyzluz5lG2K9d8VfW3vsSv9XFBSF4zgG_sp1f1FF4eVWFAAVBQ2KwjknWfvPvd9kf9Q19be6JV57bo3jR7f59DhyKXm3Thm43DmX31D7c_snAAD__x-EV38) and positions within the Middle East since October. Biden says he believes the assaults are being carried out by proxies of the Iranian government.
## Amazon TV: Watch Ads or Pay a Fee
Amazon Prime Video began charging subscribers [an extra 2.99 a month](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uhDAQBp_GdEa75sdc4SIN3aVNiRZ7fbeRwQisI8nTR6RO90mfNKP5uE93kiTr450WdiXmiXyRF0-oG9SmndoquMhsuKnYoYXeIkIP1dP1Q4hAdua583MzDICxC_OtI4t-sDBX4gyYFrBBhK5HrG3fNZag8xzD4NtBtcBBSt7rzyxreXJM3_nFe-3zUiX3LGU7VPOmzKjMeJ5nTV-Sj-tVZrzYyoyA174pM9JCP3nV2y4L65cEzprCoSnouDPrLdFa7S5sp6QkR29VC4-FJP3Zyr_tvwEAAP__6axZJA) Monday to remove ads from its programming. Pushback to the move was fierce on social media. Customers pay their $14.99 a month to Prime for free shipping and, until now, the ad-free TV service was thrown in for free. Amazon has 200 million Prime subscribers, making it one of the biggest ad platforms available. Analysts said the ads could generate [an extra $3 billion-$4 billion ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb0RwxoYMDF3Y0rWjdYUjuco2EaZE6ddX6dz5SU9P7-OyXJBX3q_vuJFvuSwYG3datBy1BLOYIflMBDQO5LVVs9VazWq4-RztOaF28azip53PkWZrXLYKDKqMaWAPCozSo9ZqmrU-2XkaLaopUk4uGieMosSt1NNX4b3dKK_P0qmeYtmG1d9aux9ifBMQBISOlak9X0xAeJkFhNYFhJ0eh4CAG_6UXd4rbyQ7JyoSU6fa-OD9Kit12r9J5lIp4tGkhnFyzjk1CQhD9en-4HXlY7bCqOuGvP51tH-v_AYAAP__BL9iqw)in the next two years, plus another $500 million of fees to avoid ads.

| Flying together with: [](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ9m6UDe9WLfFS5-CdHdX52UEhmzPhxxgMC5KG8fOUqZZkajmeLTvN2Gm09LWh___VNcjtvgQ04vGbDWWBMPXE0uipDoShxaZSyiMqqanWC0IzOFyBhjEIM0GgqB2xDGUa5VcqSIFWpE1RrExppWW6_aIHG6BL4AK5lS3o7mfUtrniUuX9tLjiZsz2pxc877CfofUA_Ux7FZfUHbfZ7LAqg_piLNPu-g-zNNoDskw0Bm_xhBd8SqtRrIBCzpl6a-9zEdZ66vSpWOQHfFNeju3leHm_bPtCzpNBZYPZ4-LT9E-c9_vgMAAP__OYNf_w "NativePath") **What are you doing to keep your mind sharp as you age?** Do you ever walk into a room and then forget why you're there? Or struggle to recall someone's name? Contrary to what you might believe... memory loss is NOT a normal part of aging. Memory loss can be incredibly frustrating and a little embarrassing to talk about. _But there is one thing you can do to regrow brain neurons and stay sharp well into your golden years._ It's not crossword puzzles or brain games... name: Scott Parkinson
subject: NEWSLETTER: Scott Parkinson for US Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Parkinson for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Fellow Patriot, I’ve been incredibly busy since the holidays campaigning all over Virginia. Our momentum is building, and I wanted to share an update from the campaign trail. Here are some pictures and a summary of the last week. **Monday, January 22:** I started out in my hometown of Arlington speaking with the Arlington GOP Committee, which also included the Arlington-Falls Church Young Republicans. I had a couple friends with me helping collect signatures and after I finished speaking we took off for Prince William County to speak with their Republican Committee. **
---
---
**Tuesday, January 23:** I spent the day making political and fundraising calls. But Cortlynn and I took the evening off, had some friends watch our four children, and we got a night out for dinner in McLean to celebrate our anniversary. I’m grateful for the love, encouragement, and prayers my wife gives me every day. She is my teammate in this race, and it was really nice to be able to spend an evening together and celebrate our marriage. ** **Wednesday, January 24: **I woke up earlier than normal around 4:45am and hit the road around 5:45am to drive to Richmond. In Richmond, I made the rounds at the General Assembly and met with a bunch of Virginia Delegates and State Senators. The legislators were pretty busy and I was in one office talking with staff when the administrative assistant came back asking if someone could speak with a large group of Virginia’s car dealers? I’m sure she meant the staff, but I decided to pop back out into the hallway and talked with about 15 people about various issues involving the automotive industry. It reminded me of my own days as a staffer when I’d take countless meetings like that in the Senate. Next, I hit the road and spoke to the Williamsburg James City County Republican Committee (WJCCRC). **
---
---
**Thursday, January 25:** Thursday morning I drove the kids to school and then I drove to Loudoun County to meet with some local leaders about parents’ rights. Loudoun continues to be the epicenter of this important issue, which is a pillar of my campaign. That evening I went to Spotsylvania County and spoke to their Republican Committee. At each of these events, I’ve continued to obtain signatures to help me qualify for the ballot.**
---
---
**Friday, January 26:** Once again, I woke up early and hit the road by 5:45am. This time, I drove to Virginia Beach (I’d previously been to Virginia Beach three other times in January and 15 times overall) and arrived by 9:00am for a meeting with Sheriff Rocky Holcomb. We discussed many issues facing the Virginia Beach community like recidivism, fentanyl, mental health, and crime among the youth. Sheriff Holcomb told me about a system they have called “TRUST” which stands for Transparency, Respect, Unity, Service, and Training. I think TRUST can be applied far beyond the law enforcement community to improve relationships in lives among friends, family, and members of the community. Throughout the rest of the day I had meetings and discussions with business leaders, retirees, former political leaders, and a restaurant owner. I enjoyed meeting so many people! **
---
---
**Saturday, January 27: **I started out the morning speaking with a large crowd at the Republican Party of Virginia Beach (RPVB) Breakfast Club. The crowd was enthusiastic. I can tell momentum is growing in our direction every day. Later that morning I drove to Norfolk and Carol de Triquet held a candidate forum in front of a crowd of about 70 people. The forum included 7 out of the 8 declared candidates for the Senate race. Finally, I wrapped up the day by driving to Rice (which is near Farmville) and attended Rep. Bob Good’s campaign kickoff. Congressman Good endorsed me last year and he and his wife Tracey are good friends. I’m excited to support all five of Virginia’s Republican incumbent U.S. Representatives in their re-election. I previously attended Rep. Jen Kiggans’ campaign kickoff, and I hope to find ways to support Rep. Wittman, Rep. Cline, and Rep. Griffith in their races. I think we need to build unity in Virginia among the so-called tribes in order to defeat Tim Kaine and Joe Biden in 2024. I also think my experience gives me the ability to lead this effort and I’m going to remain focused on uniting Virginians around a message that improves the lives of all Virginians in all communities. **
---
---
**This week!** We’re off to a great start – **Monday, January 29th,** I announced the endorsement of my fourth U.S. Senator, Pete Ricketts (R-NE), who joins Ted Cruz (R-TX), Mike Lee (R-UT), and Coach Tommy Tuberville (R-AL). I’ll be traveling around NOVA throughout the week before heading back to Hampton Roads next week.****
---
---
Please feel free to share this newsletter with any friends, family, or total strangers. We need to continue to build our movement. And if you’re interested in volunteering to help us collect signatures please email [info@scottparkinson.com](mailto:info@scottparkinson.com). Finally, fundraising continues to be a top priority for my campaign. Can you chip in $51 to help me flip the U.S. Senate Majority and become the 51st Republican Senator? Please donate here:

[DONATE HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/638ea676cdd05cb5dc9f99905c540ea9/42903/757e4dd6914d75ff3947229f28c3afba/4df499174a8ce5bcc3d6b838967d376c/42903)
---
Have a great week! Scott

Sheriff Holcomb told me about a system they have called “TRUST” which stands for Transparency, Respect, Unity, Service, and Training. I think TRUST can be applied far beyond the law enforcement community to improve relationships in lives among friends, family, and members of the community. Throughout the rest of the day I had meetings and discussions with business leaders, retirees, former political leaders, and a restaurant owner. I enjoyed meeting so many people! Saturday, January 27: I started out the morning speaking with a large crowd at the Republican Party of Virginia Beach (RPVB) Breakfast Club. The crowd was enthusiastic. I can tell momentum is growing in our direction every day. Later that morning I drove to Norfolk and Carol de Triquet held a candidate forum in front of a crowd of about 70 people. The forum included 7 out of the 8 declared candidates for the Senate race. Finally, I wrapped up the day by driving to Rice (which is near Farmville) and attended Rep. Bob Good’s campaign kickoff. Congressman Good endorsed me last year and he and his wife Tracey are good friends. I’m excited to support all five of Virginia’s Republican incumbent U.S. Representatives in their re-election. I previously attended Rep. Jen Kiggans’ campaign kickoff, and I hope to find ways to support Rep. Wittman, Rep. Cline, and Rep. Griffith in their races. I think we need to build unity in Virginia among the so-called tribes in order to defeat Tim Kaine and Joe Biden in 2024. I also think my experience gives me the ability to lead this effort and I’m going to remain focused on uniting Virginians around a message that improves the lives of all Virginians in all communities. This week! We’re off to a great start – Monday, January 29th, I announced the endorsement of my fourth U.S. Senator, Pete Ricketts (R-NE), who joins Ted Cruz (R-TX), Mike Lee (R-UT), and Coach Tommy Tuberville (R-AL). I’ll be traveling around NOVA throughout the week before heading back to Hampton Roads next week.**** Please feel free to share this newsletter with any friends, family, or total strangers. We need to continue to build our movement. And if you’re interested in volunteering to help us collect signatures please email mailto:info@scottparkinson.com. Finally, fundraising continues to be a top priority for my campaign. Can you chip in $51 to help me flip the U.S. Senate Majority and become the 51st Republican Senator? Please donate here: Have a great week! Scott | | Paid for by Parkinson for Senate | |

body:

| | | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62749597:W68O7KiN5:m:1:2532013465:D6B1B044F0953CB6724F76A0C2B86E53:r)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62749597:W68O7KiN5:m:1:2532013465:D6B1B044F0953CB6724F76A0C2B86E53:r) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62749597:W68O7KiN5:m:1:2532013465:D6B1B044F0953CB6724F76A0C2B86E53:r)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62749597:W68O7KiN5:m:1:2532013465:D6B1B044F0953CB6724F76A0C2B86E53:r)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Taking the Hill
subject: Congrats Chairman - Celebrate with us 2/22
body:
https://www.takingthehillpac.com/ [https://www.takingthehillpac.com/]
Friend - exciting news:
Our Taking the Hill PAC Chairman Dan Kunze made history by helping secure the first ever Nationwide Traffic Coordination Center for Space (TraCSS) with the Department of Commerce & LeoLabs.
We all know the five domains of war are Air, Land, Sea, Space & Cyber. Space in increasing vital to protect American interests, in fact, the Space Force budget received the highest budget increase (15%) in DOD for 2024 ($30 billion annual budget vs $53.2 billion for the Marine Corps. Congrats to Chairman Kunze for being tip of the spear!
Also, if you're in the D.C area or can support online please join us and/or support our second ever ‘Celebrating Black History Month’ event Feb 22nd where we’ll honor the Black Members of Congress who are Military Veterans. Event will be Thursday 2/22 from 6-8 at the Oracle Townhouse (link & invitation below). This is our first event in such a pivotal Presidential year. With the amount of Veterans serving in Congress at an historic low, we truly need your help. Join our host committee and please help spread the word.
Looking forward to a great year. Hope to see you on 2/22! -Patrick

body:
I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbi115rt6ec776rgk9cnq4ie2u4lvul4d52vcc9o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs)
---

Friend,

Political elites want you to think that this is over - that your vote doesn't matter.

Nothing could be further from the truth.

**We aren 't going to let the establishment tell us what to do. **

There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina!

We're just getting started in this race!

**[Will you join me in this fight to save our future today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgqvcfomkusjjipnseo8hbgadpbcnrerra01s5bo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs "Will you join me in this fight to save our future today?")**

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfpjfbknnp2p18v7h3hfblj52trqeq9h4d7v6n70_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs)
---

**I 've taken on the political elites before, and I'm ready to do it again.**

When I ran my first race for state legislator, I ran against a 30-year incumbent.

Once I realized he was related to half the district, the only option was to win.

No one thought I stood a chance. But I got to work to get my message out to voters, and one voter at a time I began to gain steam.

_**And after a lot of hard work, the district took a chance on me and we WON. **_

When I ran for Governor of South Carolina, I ran against a Lieutenant Governor, an attorney general, a very popular Congressman, and a State Senator.

I was known as "Nikki who." I had 3% in the polls, and I was seen as the underdog.

_**But once again, that didn 't matter. We fought and we WON. **_

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9m1d76ji07ahg8a9vio7s8pr2ld5365np1l0890_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs)
---

Every time I've run for office in South Carolina, I've beaten the political establishment.

Now they're lined up against me again. _**Why?**_

I've made it clear that we need to have term limits in Washington. We need a leader to hold government accountable. We need a leader who will stop the spending, stop the earmarks, and get government working for the people again.

Our movement and our campaign is made up of is people like you and me who are working every day to make sure our kids and our future generations have a better life than we did. We're working to make sure they know the opportunities the American Dream has to offer.

**[So whether the political elite like it or not, I'm not going to back down from this fight and it's clear voters across America are with me.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd85gurrl0sebh20fkint5h0g8imo5v4h9slrnco_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs "So whether the political elite like it or not, I’m not going to back down from this fight and it’s clear voters across America are with me. ")**

Supporters are **FLOODING** to our movement because they want a choice to move on from the drama and chaos.

And they want a choice to elect a new generational leader this election-- a leader who is going to work for them and offer the solutions our country is looking for!

**[Our campaign is the last hope to get our party and our country back on track, and with your support, we're going to get the job done.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za5rr5779carooftqgvd5cp0es1efbcgig8165s0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs "Our campaign is the last hope to get our party and our country back on track, and with your support, we’re going to get the job done. ")**

With you by my side, we will **FIGHT** to save the future of our great nation.
---

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp7d8kvl6ain43f3u9b744p4b16tf322o5s0jep0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs)

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgqcf73hgs542mqkgtspmkdcq1gj36jhso6pvir8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth6eor2cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Our mission at GIFFORDS is to create a future where we no longer have to live in fear from the threat of gun violence. The only way we can fuel our work is when people like you chip in to messages like these. name: Nikki Haley
subject: History lesson
body:
I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf4vb2k2uf8rrqn3g95qnca0b3qvhr925n7tfpoo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs)
---

Friend,

Political elites want you to think that this is over - that your vote doesn't matter.

Nothing could be further from the truth.

**We aren 't going to let the establishment tell us what to do. **

There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina!

We're just getting started in this race!

**[Will you join me in this fight to save our future today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm4ptid730unj3i9l0dmqt9hdo3mf1eooqclhmlg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs "Will you join me in this fight to save our future today?")**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z773sc6opu7btk5001nb38fno2jv3klkrgc3bdig_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs)
---

**I 've taken on the political elites before, and I'm ready to do it again.**

When I ran my first race for state legislator, I ran against a 30-year incumbent.

Once I realized he was related to half the district, the only option was to win.

No one thought I stood a chance. But I got to work to get my message out to voters, and one voter at a time I began to gain steam.

_**And after a lot of hard work, the district took a chance on me and we WON. **_

When I ran for Governor of South Carolina, I ran against a Lieutenant Governor, an attorney general, a very popular Congressman, and a State Senator.

I was known as "Nikki who." I had 3% in the polls, and I was seen as the underdog.

_**But once again, that didn 't matter. We fought and we WON. **_

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdbemkef3vcj62jltf2jh7vmjatjksuc133sqtj0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs)
---

Every time I've run for office in South Carolina, I've beaten the political establishment.

Now they're lined up against me again. _**Why?**_

I've made it clear that we need to have term limits in Washington. We need a leader to hold government accountable. We need a leader who will stop the spending, stop the earmarks, and get government working for the people again.

Our movement and our campaign is made up of is people like you and me who are working every day to make sure our kids and our future generations have a better life than we did. We're working to make sure they know the opportunities the American Dream has to offer.

**[So whether the political elite like it or not, I'm not going to back down from this fight and it's clear voters across America are with me.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zov7k1hcu1vlmeqnf50s8ssd20mjfrcgvisvio7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs "So whether the political elite like it or not, I’m not going to back down from this fight and it’s clear voters across America are with me. ")**

Supporters are **FLOODING** to our movement because they want a choice to move on from the drama and chaos.

And they want a choice to elect a new generational leader this election-- a leader who is going to work for them and offer the solutions our country is looking for!

**[Our campaign is the last hope to get our party and our country back on track, and with your support, we're going to get the job done.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn4cgq1vj8ga1gtb9huoa9r1b58n79oo480bskao_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs "Our campaign is the last hope to get our party and our country back on track, and with your support, we’re going to get the job done. ")**

With you by my side, we will **FIGHT** to save the future of our great nation.
---

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8dqg36lj11vo5c9en6nj5ehhqg9mokt4j7umtso_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs)

---

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3aohc6sflg28nms4653ni33e9lv260ik9d56aeg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cth69ob2cdh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

body:
Last week, I visited the U.S southern border with Mexico to see just how badly the Biden Administration is endangering Americans with his open borders | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6f7e32b4c681/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13693205?e=00028e5542)
---
[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5e261ce105&e=00028e5542)
**WATCH: My video from the wide open southern border**
Fellow Patriot,
Last week, I visited the U.S southern border with Mexico to see just how badly the President Biden is endangering Americans with his open borders policy.
I’m saddened to report that the situation is even worse than I could have imagined. Thousands of illegal aliens are pouring over the border daily and instead of being deported, are actually being released into our country. American soil has become disputed cartel territory. Violence is rampant. Lawlessness has become normal.
I made a recap video of my time at the border, to help show you exactly what’s happening.
WATCH: My video from the wide open southern border

[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=336b1e2911&e=00028e5542)
The sad part is, fellow patriot, our establishment Republican Congress is complicit in this disaster.
That’s why it’s crucial that we elect strong, conservative leaders like me who understand the scope of this problem, so we can begin to fix it.
I’m running against one of those establishment RINOs here in Florida’s 12th Congressional District.
My opponent, Rep. Gus Bilirakis, says he is working to secure the border. Well, he’s had 18 years in office to get that done, and in that time, our border crisis has reached a fever pitch.
More illegal aliens are crossing now than ever before. The cartels are wreaking havoc like they never have, and we can’t let this failure of leadership in Washington stand.
After you watch my video, [**I’m asking you to partner with me to save our nation and contribute to my campaign**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=af5a3f1034&e=00028e5542) to put an end to this madness once and for all.
[**By chipping in $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more to my election campaign today, you’re helping to send a conservative leader to Congress.**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5539cf2f4e&e=00028e5542)
When I’m in Washington, I won’t stop until the Democrats and establishment Republicans finally close our border and end this madness for good.
Thank you in advance for your generous [**support**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=1806dac570&e=00028e5542).
For God and Country,
James JudgeRepublican for U.S. Congress, FL-12
_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

Peter, I wish I had a better update. **But with just hours left before our _first_ end-of-month deadline of 2024, we're still $7,492 short of our goal.**
It is so important that we stick together to ensure we _never_ have a repeat of 2016. Too many were quick to forget the horrors of the previous administration and the lies and manipulation that convinced thousands to attempt to bring down our democracy.

body:
Two December polls show me being pushed out of the primary.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37153%2E3422442%2EiNeXX5)
Derek,
I’m a straight shooter, and I take a lot of pride in these emails being honest and transparent. **That means telling you I could lose our race for the U.S. Senate.**
**Two December polls show me being pushed out of the primary. That means my time in Congress would come to an end.**
**Here’s why: California has a unique system. The top two vote-getters in March’s primary advance to the general election in November.**Early polling suggests that I am in a very strong position to win the general election, no matter the other candidate, but the math in this primary is weird.** A celebrity Republican is gaining traction in the polls, and he could advance to second place and keep us from qualifying for the general election.**
****Election Day is less than five weeks away, but Californians begin voting even sooner.** Ballots get mailed out next week, and with 20% of voters undecided, there’s no time to waste. Just a single ad--whether on TV or online--can change a voter's mind or inspire them to get their ballot in.**

Katie

I’m at my wits’ end

| | |
I’m at my wits’ end, Friend.

Biden and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. Now their sights are set on me.

At this point, if I don’t do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I lose my House seat, Republicans may never hold the majority in Congress again.

**Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump’s Secretary of the Interior and I was the commander at SEAL Team 6.**
**I’m also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation.**

But if Biden can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.

**In 2022, I lead the team of Navy SEAL’s that retook the House Majority, and I have more battle experience than anyone else. Point is, I’m one of the toughest, most battle-tested Republicans in Washington D.C. If I can’t beat the Democrats gunning for my seat - no one can.**

Peter,
When I decided to run for office to represent the 15th District of the Missouri State Senate, I set down a few key rules for how my team and I would run this campaign:

Focus

change—

show
how
we
can
do
it.
Politics should be uplifting. It should be about people of all backgrounds coming together to solve problems and make change happen. Not the vanity contests and mud-slinging race to the bottom that turns good people off and ruins their faith in democracy.
I have two beautiful young granddaughters who also live in the 15th District, and I think of them before I do any of this. I think of making them proud...and I think of what kind of world and society they will inherit.
I also think of the hundreds of people, many of them new to politics and getting involved for the first time, who are in this because they believe we still can—and should—settle our differences peacefully and democratically. We owe it to them to run a sharp, disciplined, principled campaign that can win.

---

Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics, friend?
While serving as the president of Nevada's largest synagogue, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – **because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.** **In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.**
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country.** ** And as we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on reproductive freedom to threats to tear down our very democracy, I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

Peter, As we close out the first month of the election year, instead of hitting you with some BS fundraising email with a fake deadline, I wanted to just take a moment to share with you _why I’m in this race._ I’m running for Congress, not for personal gain or media coverage. I’m in this fight because this is a pivotal moment for Arizona and America. _So much is on the line._ The future of the American Dream, of our democracy, and of our very planet is all in the hands of the decisions made in Congress. **When I think of all that is at stake in this moment and that the future of my two children is in the hands of extremists like our current Congressperson, David Schweikert, I can’t just sit on the sidelines.** As the grandson of four Holocaust survivors and son of refugees from communism, democracy and freedom aren’t abstract ideas to me, they’ve always been _real._ And it’s what’s inspired me my entire career to work to protect our fragile democracy, expand opportunity and fairness, and meet critical issues, like the climate crisis, head-on. In Congress, I’ll continue to work to better the lives of those in my community and beyond. I’ll be ready on day one to deliver for you because I know that _we don’t have a moment to waste_ when it comes to building an economy that works for all, fighting the climate crisis, and protecting democracy and freedom. **This fight hasn’t been easy, and it won’t get any easier as we get further into 2024, but I know that this team has what it takes to help us win.** We’ve already broken the all-time Congressional fundraising record in Arizona, and together we can keep up the momentum to ensure we defeat David Schweikert, flipping this battleground district blue. body:
#
Friends,
At midnight tonight, we close the books on our January fundraising deadline — our first deadline of the year. If you understand the urgency of this deadline and that’s all you need to hear, please use this link to donate:
[**https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/JanuaryDeadline**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.Ibl7yb&refcode=em240131-1-tt&t=1&akid=5180%2E196590%2ETacMtq)
Otherwise, please give me a chance to explain why your support is so important right now:
This month has shown us just how vulnerable our democracy is. From Republican legislators trying to pass a 14-week abortion ban in Wisconsin to Trump winning in New Hampshire and Iowa and claiming that he has “complete and total presidential immunity” even if he ordered SEAL Team Six to kill his political opponents, it's crystal clear that our democracy is in danger.
While Democrats continue to legislate and fight for the betterment of our country, Republicans keep trying to move our country toward fascism. Extremists are making a mockery of our democracy, and we cannot let it persist.
With Primary Elections underway and the General Election approaching, it has become clear that this election may be one of the most important of our lifetimes. Because it will determine the future of our democracy and whether America will yield to MAGA extremism.
Simply put, our democracy is on the ballot.
But we have the power, together, to protect fundamental rights and our democracy at the ballot box. Collectively, we CAN flip the Wisconsin State Legislature and the People’s House blue, and keep control of the Senate and White House.
We have already endorsed and supported several candidates who will help make that a reality. But to continue supporting them, we are going to need a lot of resources and hit our fundraising goal at midnight tonight.
So I am asking:
[**Can you please contribute $3 or whatever you can afford to the Long Run before our January fundraising deadline at midnight? We need your help to continue supporting Democrats up and down the ballot.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.Ibl7yb&refcode=em240131-1-tt&t=2&akid=5180%2E196590%2ETacMtq)

[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.q3rIbz&refcode=em240131-1-tt&t=23&akid=5180%2E196590%2ETacMtq)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.hytGtw&refcode=em240131-1-tt&t=24&akid=5180%2E196590%2ETacMtq)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.w31MA1&refcode=em240131-1-tt&t=25&akid=5180%2E196590%2ETacMtq)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.Ibl7yb&refcode=em240131-1-tt&t=26&akid=5180%2E196590%2ETacMtq)
When I launched the Long Run, I knew I would need to count on folks like you — people who would continue to help build our movement for a better country. Today, I am hoping you can step up to make that a reality.
With gratitude,
Mandela

Trump and his campaign attacked those parents because they have no conception of honor. But they also did it because they are afraid
#
Derek, this is Paul Eaton. Retired Major General with the U.S. Army, and a Gold Star Family Member.
My father was killed in action in the Vietnam War. My children will never meet him.
A few years ago I was absolutely disgusted to hear Trump’s comments insulting Americans who gave the ultimate sacrifice. Calling them “suckers” and “losers.”
VoteVets ran an ad over the weekend, making sure that Americans know what Trump thinks of our honored dead.
And on cue, the Trump campaign attacked that ad, attacked this organization — and worst of all, they attacked the Gold Star Parents who appeared in that ad.
Called them “vile” and “shills.”
Trump and his campaign attacked those parents because they have no conception of honor. But they also did it because they are afraid — afraid that people might learn what he really thinks of the men and women who serve in uniform.
They’re afraid of us. For good reason.

body:
These are some of the most important House races in the country.

Friends —
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to split a donation between four California Democrats running for Congress in closely contested House races this November.
If Democrats win these four seats, we're going to flip the House in November. And each of them has a very good chance... but only if they have our support.
If that's all you need to hear, I am asking you to split a donation between Rudy Salas, George Whitesides, Adam Gray, and Will Rollins at this link:
[**https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/Flip-House**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-em-ca-house?refcode=em240130&refcode2=1806_4767699_O99gwr&akid=1806%2E4767699%2EO99gwr)
Otherwise, let me dig in a bit here on why I am asking you to split a $3 donation between these four campaigns today.
$3 because all four of these seats were decided by just a few points in the last election, and one race by less than one percent.
$3 because in the disastrous future that Trump wins and Republicans take the Senate, Democrats NEED the House of Representatives to have any chance of stopping Trump's agenda.
$3 because Republicans know how important these seats are too, and that's why they are going to pour money into California to defend these seats.
I know that one $3 donation may not seem like it can do enough to counter all that right-wing outside spending. But let me tell you, lots and lots of people respond to these email requests — now they're hoping you'll do the same.
Because it all adds up when we all chip in, and that's how we'll win these seats and take back the House: together. So what do you say?

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.

Friend,
It’s time to take deadly seriously the threats of violence, domestic insurrection, and civil war that Republicans have made at the southern border.
Jim Jordan and Republican Gov. Greg Abbott are making the UNCONSTITUTIONAL argument that Texas has a right to control the border, and the federal government doesn’t. These two extremists claim that the “compact between the United States and the States” is broken—almost exactly what South Carolina said in its 1860 declaration of secession.

Jordan, Greg Abbott, and Donald Trump are DELIBERATELY sabotaging national security at the border to try and gain points politically—meanwhile, promising bipartisan negotiations in the Senate have produced a draft agreement on landmark compromise immigration legislation, the first since the 1990s.
Coming from an agricultural district I know how critical immigrant labor is for the success of our harvests. I am constantly talking to farmers who tell me that if immigrant labor dried up their farms would go under. It wasn't too long ago when moderate Republicans like George Bush duked it out with other Republicans in the 2000 GOP Presidential Primary to see who could be _the most compassionate_ towards immigrants in hopes of wooing latinos to their side - now the discourse has flipped in the GOP to _who can be the most cruel_ towards immigrants. Working Ohioans are fed up with chaos at the border caused by career politicians like Jordan.
This is craziness, but Jordan won’t ever voluntarily stop harming our country to benefit himself—it’s just who he is. We need to MAKE him stop by beating him this year.
