name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Sounding the alarm on AIPAC
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
**First,** last month we emailed you on how AIPAC — the wealthy, conservative, pro-Israel PAC — is recruiting Democratic primary challengers to defeat Alexandria and five other Squad members this election year.
**Then** , we just found out that since October, AIPAC has spent more than $1 million on Facebook ads, funneling money from GOP megadonors to exclusively target progressive candidates.
This is the same group that provided unconditional support to the 109 Republicans who refused to certify the 2020 presidential election.
**Now Alexandria needs you to have her back.**
[Will you contribute $5 today to ensure our campaign has the resources to fight back against AIPAC’s massive spending against our progressive movement?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240131.wjmWJo&refcode=em20240131-5737-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5737%2E2526796%2EGxG6uK)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240131.wjmWJo&refcode=em20240131-5737-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5737%2E2526796%2EGxG6uK)**
AIPAC doesn’t like that Alexandria supports a bilateral ceasefire in Gaza — even though that’s an opinion shared by 61% of Americans, regardless of political party.1
AIPAC and its super PAC, United Democracy Project, spent $30 million in 2022’s Democratic primaries, entirely focused against just 8 progressive candidates, many of whom were candidates of color. They helped defeat 6 of them.
AIPAC is seriously scaling up to spread their regressive and right-wing agenda. When a right-wing group attacks Alexandria and our entire progressive movement, it’s imperative that we have the resources to fight back.
[Will you contribute $5 right now to help us defeat AIPAC? AIPAC is going after Alexandria this election year and we need to be prepared.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240131.wjmWJo&refcode=em20240131-5737-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5737%2E2526796%2EGxG6uK)
In solidarity,
Team AOC

| | | AIPAC’s dark money grift is backfiring, Peter. Last week, Rep. Summer Lee — a member of the progressive Squad in Congress and a major target of Republican-funded Super PACs this cycle — **announced her re-election campaign has raised over $1 million, with more than _90 percent_ of the contributions from small-dollar donors.1** These numbers show us two things:
1. **AIPAC’s threats are lighting a fire under all of us to protect and expand democracy.** The news that AIPAC is planning to spend at least $100 million to unseat progressive champions like Summer and take full control of Congress for MAGA Republicans has _activated_ our multigenerational, multiracial movement to strengthen the line of defense against corruption.
2. **We have the overwhelming power of the people.** Summer is going into this cycle with a real enthusiasm edge over her top primary opponent — who’s reportedly been “in touch” with AIPAC1 —and nearly all of it is thanks to small-dollar donations from _real_ people inspired to give what they can, when they can.

AIPAC and the billionaire right-wing donors who fund them aren’t taking _any_ of this lightly — and there’s a chance this news will provoke them to intensify their attacks against Summer in order to crush the momentum we’re seeing in this race. Summer Lee — a member of the progressive Squad in Congress and a major target of Republican-funded Super PACs this cycle — announced her re-election campaign has raised over $1 million, with more than 90 percent of the contributions from small-dollar donors.1 These numbers show us two things: 1. AIPAC’s threats are lighting a fire under all of us to protect and expand democracy. The news that AIPAC is planning to spend at least $100 million to unseat progressive champions like Summer and take full control of Congress for MAGA Republicans has activated our multigenerational, multiracial movement to strengthen the line of defense against corruption. 2. We have the overwhelming power of the people. Summer is going into this cycle with a real enthusiasm edge over her top primary opponent — who’s reportedly been “in touch” with AIPAC1 —and nearly all of it is thanks to small-dollar donations from real people inspired to give what they can, when they can. AIPAC and the billionaire right-wing donors who fund them aren’t taking any of this lightly — and there’s a chance this news will provoke them to intensify their attacks against Summer in order to crush the momentum we’re seeing in this race. The only way working people have ever been able to fight back against the kind of money groups like AIPAC have is through the support of grassroots donors like you, Peter. And support at this stage of the election cycle means the most of all. Thank you, as always, for all of your contributions to our Working Families Party champions. Whether through your financial support or by giving your time and talents, you are helping us build power to take on — and defeat — the wealthy donor class. Ritchie is the first openly LGBTQ+ Afro-Latino man in Congress.
Raised by a single mother, he never thought he’d go from public housing in the Bronx to the halls of Congress in D.C.

Requires each local school board to develop and implement a policy to require the annual notification of the parent of each student enrolled in the local school division, to be sent by email and SMS text message within 30 calendar days succeeding the first day of each school year, of the parent's legal responsibility to safely store any firearm present in the household, risks associated with improperly stored firearms, statistics relating to firearm-related accidents, injuries, and death among youth, and other tips and strategies. The bill requires each school board to make such parental notification available in multiple languages on its website.
[S.B. 379](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RvE6Tc3JEct6glOWFggM9yEw_33B4HiaVVpfGk3ZsXDOCehdGj4OpCxkBTwOzbHY94NypnNZBJaajaPlSUp64tumJENQ7TuT4mpCdc2DZODddmcvVVP4iRaT_NZMDV8KiEaBxHiX9xuEKbnMcpiLk7p1KDvxQwQ8MwWToRdcu9PcHKVIn1jIrmlDoBgdVTyYOPKHQQvT5E0=&c=YvpYfP4ACtCKKoKpQM4idDvZufW1XGOOuOXpc_uUT-sKf8kxczhk9Q==&ch=oTKbK59xWJKQrnz-sjp6L7V6R2mdePDJ417_mZMSqoB_bPZ-EmzOAw==) Patron: Boysko Public high schools; research-based hazing prevention instruction. Requires each local school board to develop a program of research-based hazing prevention instruction to be provided to students in grade nine or 10 as a part of their physical and health education.

Provides that no public elementary or secondary school student is permitted to be a participant on or try out for any school athletic team or squad with a predetermined roster, regular practices, and scheduled competitions with other elementary or secondary schools unless such student has submitted to the school principal a signed report from a licensed physician, licensed advanced practice registered nurse, or licensed physician assistant acting under the supervision of a licensed physician attesting that such student has, within the preceding 365 days, received both a physical examination and a mental health assessment.

Prohibits passenger vehicle exhaust systems from emitting noise in excess of 95 decibels in Planning District 8 on any highway; driveway or premises of a church, school, recreational facility, or business; any governmental property open to the public; any industrial establishment providing parking space for customers, patrons, or employees; and any highway under construction or not yet open to the public. The bill allows, in Planning District 8, a law-enforcement officer to stop a passenger vehicle he determines is emitting exhaust system noise in excess of such limit and issue a notice of an administrative fee of $250 to be assessed at the time of the vehicle's next registration renewal and establishes a process for inspecting such vehicle.

Requires each local school board to develop and implement a policy to require the annual notification of the parent of each student enrolled in the local school division, to be sent by email and SMS text message within 30 calendar days succeeding the first day of each school year, of the parent's legal responsibility to safely store any firearm present in the household, risks associated with improperly stored firearms, statistics relating to firearm-related accidents, injuries, and death among youth, and other tips and strategies. The bill requires each school board to make such parental notification available in multiple languages on its website. == Patron: Boysko Public high schools; research-based hazing prevention instruction. Requires each local school board to develop a program of research-based hazing prevention instruction to be provided to students in grade nine or 10 as a part of their physical and health education. == Patron: Pekarsky Public elementary and secondary schools; student athletes; pre-participation mental health assessment required. Provides that no public elementary or secondary school student is permitted to be a participant on or try out for any school athletic team or squad with a predetermined roster, regular practices, and scheduled competitions with other elementary or secondary schools unless such student has submitted to the school principal a signed report from a licensed physician, licensed advanced practice registered nurse, or licensed physician assistant acting under the supervision of a licensed physician attesting that such student has, within the preceding 365 days, received both a physical examination and a mental health assessment. == Patron: Carroll Foy School-connected overdoses; policies relating to parental notification and response; requirements. The bill also directs the Department of Motor Vehicles to implement the extended validity periods for such documents upon reissuance. == Patron: Marsden Vehicle exhaust systems; inspection and administrative fee. Friend,

I never thought I'd have running water, let alone be running for Congress.

My name is Mazi Melesa Pilip, but you can call me Mazi for short!

I'm the Republican nominee running in the New York special election that was just declared.

If you don't already know- this is the one & only seat we absolutely have to win to defend the House Majority.

I'm a black, Jewish woman & I'm not afraid to tell you that I am 100% Pro-Law Enforcement, Pro-Border security, and Pro-Family.

Democrats & the liberal media have spent years saying the GOP will never support someone of my ethnicity & my creed.

They say women like me don't exist & that we can't be any of those things.

And now they're spending millions to bury me in negative headlines, hit pieces, and TV commercials.

They take great pleasure in laying waste to minority women who don't fall in line with their sacred narrative.

And without your help today- I'm afraid I'm going to be one of them.

body:

| | Dear **Friend** , The Twelfth Congressional District has long been a progressive, multiracial, enlightened beacon for California and the country — we lead with an example of a progressive, people-centered approach to challenges and show what democracy is truly about. Our district’s strength is a distinct reminder of the late, great warrior for peace and justice Ron Dellums, my predecessor, and who I consider to be the father of coalition politics. **After his 27 years of service, he passed the baton to me — and now, I am excited and proud to endorse Lateefah Simon, my former student and true fighter for peace and justice, to run this next lap of the race.** [](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/vs2jHQ9f-fY43gA5lGLK3w~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnnSMdP0RGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xlZWFuZHNpbW9uP3JlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD03MDQ0MTE5OVcDc3BjQgplujGeumWSB5OKUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAEQ~~) | | [SUPPORT OUR CAMPAIGNS TODAY!](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/vs2jHQ9f-fY43gA5lGLK3w~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnnSMdP0RGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xlZWFuZHNpbW9uP3JlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD03MDQ0MTE5OVcDc3BjQgplujGeumWSB5OKUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAEQ~~)
---
Lateefah is from the community, and for the community. From her teenage years working to support young women and trans youth, to fighting to make public transit more affordable and accessible, she is a fierce advocate and proven leader. It’s my honor to pass the blue baton to Lateefah, who I trust to stand up for the values of the 12th District, and continue building the broad coalition working together for a better world.
Representation matters, and throughout my career, I’ve worked to uplift women and build a pipeline for leaders in our communities. We have been smart, we’ve been strategic, and we’ve always brought other Black women and other women of color with us.
**But let me be clear, Black women have to work twice as hard to win elections so we are counting on you. **[**Will you contribute today to our campaigns?**](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/vs2jHQ9f-fY43gA5lGLK3w~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnnSMdP0RGaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xlZWFuZHNpbW9uP3JlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD03MDQ0MTE5OVcDc3BjQgplujGeumWSB5OKUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAEQ~~)
I am ready to take our fight to the Senate and be the champion Californians need and I know Lateefah is ready to do the same for CA-12. Join us and let’s make history.
Thank you,
Barbara Lee

Hello folks, my colleague, Congressman Frank Mrvan from Indiana, asked me to pass along this message. We're both Frontline Democrats and strong supporters of organized labor. I hope you’ll take a moment to read his note and support our shared efforts to continue fighting for working families in Congress. — Nikki
* * *
I’ve been working hard to deliver results for Northwest Indiana, from voting to pass legislation like the _Inflation Reduction Act_ which strengthened our economy and lowered prescription drug costs, to introducing the _Safe Recovery Together Act_ , legislation that supports survivors of domestic violence. But divisive House Republicans are focused more on causing chaos and disorder than finding common ground. Friend, While the Republican presidential primaries were playing out in Iowa and New Hampshire, Donald Trump spent most of that time in a courtroom. Over the next ten months, we’ll see Donald Trump fighting for his freedom and future. But if he wins re-election, we’re not going to see him fight for any of ours. This election year is critical. Our country cannot afford another four years of a Trump presidency. Another four years of Trump means he gets another shot at taking away our hard-fought rights. It’s up to us to not give him that opportunity. There is so much at stake — and right here in Maryland, we’ve taken leadership to protect abortion access and create economic opportunity for Marylanders. We will not stop until we’ve secured these rights and freedoms for all of us across the country. We will not go back, and Maryland will continue leading the way to model a government that works for all of us, not just a select few. Elevate, Wes Moore

Over the next ten months, we’ll see Donald Trump fighting for his freedom and future. But if he wins re-election, we’re not going to see him fight for any of ours. This election year is critical. Our country cannot afford another four years of a Trump presidency. Another four years of Trump means he gets another shot at taking away our hard-fought rights. It’s up to us to not give him that opportunity. There is so much at stake — and right here in Maryland, we’ve taken leadership to protect abortion access and create economic opportunity for Marylanders. We will not stop until we’ve secured these rights and freedoms for all of us across the country. We will not go back, and Maryland will continue leading the way to model a government that works for all of us, not just a select few. Elevate, Wes Moore

| January 31, 2024
Friend,
As you remember, I ran for Governor in 2022 with a clear plan for how to manage the Commonwealth and to be ready to handle any crisis that may arise.
Today my former opponent, Governor Maura Healey, was on the news for closing a Roxbury community center, for the purpose of housing more illegal immigrants. Around 400 more to be exact!
In a time where costs such as housing, groceries, and daycare are at record highs; our Governor thought it was a good idea to close a community center that plays such an important role in the greater Boston area.
Her excuse, in her exact words, "We're here today because we really don't have a choice,"
Really? We don't have a choice?
Imagine being the Governor of the Commonwealth, with your party holding a supermajority in the State House and Senate, and holding every Congressional and US Senate Seat in the state, and claiming that you don't have a choice.
Governor Healey and every elected Democrat in Massachusetts has a choice. They have the majority necessary to take the votes to resolve this crisis, but they are choosing not to.
When Governor Healey said "We really don't have a choice," she really meant "YOU really don't have a choice!"
YOU really don't have a choice if your community center closes to house illegal immigrants. Say goodbye to your children's after-school programs, your children's daycare, and your family's community pool.
YOU really don't have a choice if the hotel near your house closes down to house illegal immigrants. Say goodbye to those tourist dollars.
YOU really don't have a choice if you or a loved one is a homeless veteran. Those free hotel rooms are only available to illegal immigrants.
What happens when they run out of hotels and community centers? There are plenty of senior centers and public libraries they will likely "utilize" next...
Enough is enough. The reality is, right now, you really don't have a choice in this issue. However, we have an opportunity to change this!
We need to rebuild the Massachusetts Republican Party. We can no longer allow the Democrats in power to put our Commonwealth in a crisis, and then cry on TV claiming there is nothing they can do to fix the crisis. We also need Republicans in office who will fight for us.
KathyJo and I need your support. Together, we will fight for a Republican Party that gives YOU a choice. A Republican Party that elects Representatives and Senators who will fight for your voice. A Republican Party that will be YOUR party.
You DO have a choice. We have a choice.

As soon as Nancy Pelosi [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/1725d493-3dbf-4a6d-b7b4-f30774e8175f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supporters of a ceasefire in Gaza of being tools of Russia--[or China](https://substack.com/redirect/158eae56-ddc6-4c15-9bd4-26172c79c787?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), depending on who she's responding to--I found myself suddenly tagged in a vast series of social media posts by people around the country.
[H]er recent comments did not surprise me in the least. I tried to warn voters and journalists when it could have made a difference.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e7a915fc-8f4f-4cf1-a916-430cddb3c85d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Many have long been frustrated with Pelosi's policy record, or supported my campaigns in 2018, 2020, or 2022 to replace her. Others discovered only recently that Pelosi is in fact [a far cry from the figure](https://substack.com/redirect/957adfa4-c79f-41a2-a335-0b3f1176efce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) depicted by major media sources who describe her as a champion of either women, San Francisco, or the Democratic Party.
A surprising number of voices urged me to [run for Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/e81bb342-329a-4639-a341-3ab74862f222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) again. That is not going to happen, but I continue to pursue [a legal challenge](https://substack.com/redirect/a04b4ec9-b9e9-43e2-806f-2d02fd5aa61d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the racism among journalists that enables the corporate Democratic Party's corrupt machinations, and I also continue to write to inform the public. (Thanks for reading!)
This post responds to the outrage following Pelosi's latest smears targeting critics of the bipartisan militarism that she has crucially enabled as a leader of the Democratic Party.
### **Can you hear me now?**
When I ran for Congress to challenge Pelosi for the seat she has held for 37 years without ever debating an opponent even once, what [originally motivated me](https://substack.com/redirect/5a32ec09-b23b-4a8b-98ae-d3c2f995f2a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was her consistent [support for authoritarianism](https://substack.com/redirect/e22ddb81-6587-4efe-9f54-0020b93571e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As Chair of the House Intelligence Committee and then Speaker of the House, she did more to build the contemporary mass surveillance state, and lend it bipartisan legitimacy--despite its continuing unconstitutionality--than nearly anyone in Washington. My first moment ever considering a congressional campaign was in January 2018, when [she led Congress to re-authorize the NSA's warrantless surveillance program](https://substack.com/redirect/4b3e08d4-3782-47f8-a0d7-0df322e9b140?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for six years, without any debate over its efficacy or civil liberties violations.

[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=141244191&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQxMjQ0MTkxLCJpYXQiOjE3MDY3MzE1MzUsImV4cCI6MTcwOTMyMzUzNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Gyi1LkHDR1waUm7igzB0unrZbbWssm7ff6C83qSOXLI)
That's why her recent comments did not surprise me in the least. I tried to warn voters when it could have made a difference.
On the one hand, I won more votes against Pelosi than any challenger she has ever faced by a wide margin. The 81,000 votes I received in November 2020 would be enough in many districts to win a congressional seat.
Ultimately, however, I discovered that journalists in San Francisco ultimately care more about [ad hominem lies and smears](https://substack.com/redirect/c438cdab-e290-47a5-b656-dfcaf93afec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than documented [corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/0c9a4121-61ac-46e7-b819-dd7fff392f54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or Pelosi's long record of [hamstringing](https://substack.com/redirect/989250cf-aba1-4767-ad7f-6220f7d9e5cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) particular policy [goals](https://substack.com/redirect/1741913a-d812-467b-817b-5206cd5a15c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that have [united](https://substack.com/redirect/5f06b149-c526-4610-a6d7-86a61db5a50f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) San Francisco.
### **Pelosi wants to silence Madison 's music**
Like every other Member of Congress, Nancy Pelosi [swore an oath](https://substack.com/redirect/e8ba302c-ea91-4db5-8e2f-158493f2530e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to uphold and defend the Constitution of the United States. Her latest comments suggest that [she might not have ever read it](https://substack.com/redirect/5df991e2-f198-4864-8d96-a9b177420d90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[The First Amendment](https://substack.com/redirect/2bc2775c-5a50-4864-b5b8-7e8106718ace?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) includes protections for five distinct sets of expressive acts, each of which can be understood in relation to the democratic political process.
1. The rights to free exercise of religion and against the establishment of religion aim to guard freedom of conscience
2. Freedom of speech ensures the opportunity for self-expression
3. Freedom of assembly allows people to gather, among other things, to declare support for shared ideas
4. Freedom of the press is supposed to encourage a robust landscape of institutions to ensure transparency and public accountability
5. The right to petition the government for redress of grievances represents the culmination of the other rights enshrined in the First Amendment

NYU Law professor Burt Neuborne wrote a book, "[Madison's Music](https://substack.com/redirect/631b35e6-4428-4460-95a4-58c3dbd9d573?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," that explains how the distinct rights that the First Amendment protects together form a whole greater than the sum of its parts.
One need not understand any novel constitutional theory, however, to recognize how a senior government official encouraging FBI investigations of lawful, constitutionally protected dissent represents a frontal assault on these rights, the Constitution that enshrines them, the democracy it was designed to guard, and the people it was meant to empower.

### **The FBI might have its hands full**
By suggesting that the Federal Bureau of Investigations scrutinize protests urging a ceasefire, Pelosi in fact invited an investigation targeting a majority of Americans. In November, [68% of respondents](https://substack.com/redirect/b428ae99-ac15-4bf1-88fc-f5c6cefbadb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a poll conducted by Reuters agreed that "Israel should call a ceasefire."
Last July, the U.S. Census Bureau announced its latest estimate of the country's population: 334,914,895 Americans. To the extent the Reuters poll in November remains statistically significant (and that support for a ceasefire has not grown since then, as it certainly [seems](https://substack.com/redirect/3ed2223f-5d3a-46ff-8e77-34f07dc4e696?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have), it suggests that roughly 228 million Americans favor a ceasefire.
They might need to hire a few more agents.
_[Note: My next post will focus on the FBI 's long history of suppressing dissent across the United States, and the Islamophobia and bias apparent in the Bureau's most recent round of attacks on constitutional rights. Those are themes that I've raised many times over the past 20 years and will again, but I want to keep this post focused on Pelosi.]_
### **Smearing critics is Pelosi 's stock and trade**
Nancy Pelosi faced an electoral threat [only once](https://substack.com/redirect/bcd48916-c603-49a4-9e57-aed16450ad4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in her career, from the campaign that I built with the support of 30,000 concerned Americans across the country that won 81,000 votes from San Franciscans in November 2020 to remove her from Congress while at the time serving as Speaker of the House. The political pressure we mounted forced Pelosi into half a dozen policy concessions that ultimately passed the U.S. House of Representatives, including major reforms to labor, policing, and executive accountability that she had previously opposed.
The way she retained her seat was by ducking debates, as she always has. While many clamored for a debate when I ran (which was largely the point of the initial vision for my campaign in 2018), Pelosi was able to ignore them because [a character assassination that began on my birthday](https://substack.com/redirect/b23206f4-3193-4e70-af67-7176cb1c6d90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) silenced me and destroyed my campaign three months before the election.
On the one hand, Pelosi herself said nothing about me at any point. Operatives loyal to her party, however, gained any number of opportunities from smearing me. Several won jobs in the Democratic Party and campaigns affiliated with it. Others won endorsements from Democratic Party governing bodies. Others won appointments to boards of organizations, to at least one of which Pelosi's party paid thousands of dollars.
The ranks of loyal Democrats willing to promote racist lies outrageously included self-described Socialists and Progressives. Some of them are elected officeholders, such as [Dean Preston in San Francisco](https://substack.com/redirect/b1f3618c-82e0-4c0c-8f49-bc20c3dee54a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Lissette Espinoza-Garnica in Redwood City. Others seek elected office, like Jackie Fielder in San Francisco and Brandon Harami, the Chief of Staff to the Mayor of Oakland. Entire organizations in which I once held some hope also fell prey to the pattern, including the League of Pissed Off Voters, Dramatic Socialites of America, the San Francisco Berniecrats, and the Harvey Milk Democratic Club.
Some might perceive Pelosi as standing above the fray, since [a corporate PR agent helped engineer the disinformation campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/545f3244-57e3-473e-9445-d6e2f52969e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that blocked my attempt to offer San Francisco an alternative in Washington. But [Pelosi was the beneficiary](https://substack.com/redirect/118b7538-ff1e-4a3d-abb0-ee1a3e23e9fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the smears, and the person at the top of the party that orchestrated them. Letting Pelosi off the hook for helping steer character assassination campaigns from the shadows is the equivalent of ignoring Henry Kissinger's [prolific crimes against humanity](https://substack.com/redirect/e57e6592-2393-4f71-aea8-33ea4f85d341?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite his decisions that killed more people than anyone since Hitler.
Many of the voices who misled the public in 2020 [claim today](https://substack.com/redirect/b1f3618c-82e0-4c0c-8f49-bc20c3dee54a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to stand for Palestine, despite having done everything possible to ensure that their city remains represented by a shameless agent of militarism, rather than one of its [most ardent and well-informed critics](https://substack.com/redirect/e22ddb81-6587-4efe-9f54-0020b93571e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Their hypocrisy offers evidence that the opportunism and irrationality embodied by Nancy Pelosi are not simply personal phenomena, but rather institutional and cultural ones that appear intractable.
One of the most ridiculous aspects of her latest smears is that Pelosi can't figure out whether the foreign power funding domestic dissent is Russia, or instead, China. She [referred](https://substack.com/redirect/33c166ca-4e04-4c5f-b616-d917ebe5d85e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a ceasefire as Putin's message on CNN, while [telling](https://substack.com/redirect/fa4d2b2a-e1b6-4622-b135-085763b8e232?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Code Pink activists holding a peaceful demonstration at her house to go back to China. The sheer opportunism of a rhetorical strategy based on making it up as one goes along would be bad enough, even were it not a ruse to enable preventable war, death, and destruction for profit.
_Paid subscribers can access a livestream on which I discussed these and other issues with host Jen Perelman from Jenerational Change. Like me, Jen worked for years as a public interest lawyer before running for Congress against a corporate Democrat. Today, like me, she speaks to the corruption of our political process from the standpoint of someone who tried to engage it in good faith..._

name: Katie Porter
subject: personal message about our campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
The top two vote-getters in March’s primary, regardless of party, advance to the General Election.
Hey Derek, I wanted to personally reach out with an update on our campaign. We’re currently running TV ads in four different media markets—Los Angeles, San Francisco-Oakland-San Jose, Sacramento, and San Diego.
We’re also running a wide variety of digital ads, in both Spanish and English, all across the state. Voters are learning more about our plan to shake up the Senate on Instagram, Facebook, Youtube, Snapchat and more. In a year where Americans are increasingly retreating to different corners of the internet, your resources are helping us connect with people of all ages and backgrounds.
Running these ads is critical, because recent polls show this as a tight race. I’m neck and neck with Republican celebrity Steve Garvey for second place. **And in this race, second place matters quite a bit.**
The top two vote-getters in March’s primary, regardless of party, advance to the General Election. Polling shows I’m in a very strong position to win the general election, regardless of who the other candidate is. But right now we’re at real risk of being pushed out.
That means my time in Congress would come to an end.
Derek, I need your help to make sure that doesn’t happen. **Truthfully, to win we need to be running ads in additional media markets—my opponent is already running TV ads in places we aren’t, like Palm Springs.** I’m the only candidate in this race who has never taken money from corporate PACs and doesn’t take money from federal lobbyists, so I truly count on you.
With that in mind, can you please make your first donation to our senate campaign of $5 today? **Here’s a link:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240131-2](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240131-2?refcode=em20240131-37159&refcode2=37159_3422442_gsacEY&akid=37159%2E3422442%2EgsacEY)**
I’m so grateful to have you on our team.
Katie Porter

subject: math - not magic

body:
It’s true what we say — when hundreds or thousands of folks chip in, we make a ton of progress to our goals. It adds up fast. That’s how we’ve always hit our goals, and that’s how we’ll do it tonight.
#

Peter:
From this point in the day, we need to raise about $25,000 before our deadline at midnight.
That’s not something most folks will want to admit — it’s a big number — but the way we’re going to get there is math. Not magic.
We’re asking you to chip in just $5 right now. We know that $5 doesn’t sound like the kind of donation that can add up to $25,000. But think about this:
If 5000 people chip in $5 right now we’d hit our goal. And we can tell you without any doubt that more than 5000 people are going to open this email. We just need you to take that next step and chip in.
It’s true what we say — when hundreds or even thousands of folks chip in, we make a ton of progress to our goals. It adds up fast. That’s how we’ve always hit our goals, and that’s how we’ll do it tonight.
Trump, Kari Lake, and the national GOP are going to target this seat with everything they’ve got. That’s why it’s so important that we hit those goals.
And that’s why we’re asking you:
[**PLEASE make that $5 donation before our deadline hits at midnight. We need you to add your $5 to the 5000 others before it’s too late.](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/2327?c0=ruben-em-jan24.UzpPGE&refcode=em240131-3-120&t=1&akid=1910%2E734936%2EP6tsI9)**

Friend You're invited Presidents' Day Weekend...
### Sunday, February 18, 2024, 10 am - 5 pm in NYC
# _**America's Next 50 Years**_
****Space pioneer Krafft Ehricke's conception of a lunar industrial city "Selenopolis" I cannot stress enough how important it is that you attend this conference, preferably in person. While the Global South rejects British colonialism and genocidal wars, the United States has become virtually indistinguishable from our old imperial adversary. If we don't reverse that trend, and commit ourselves to a bright and peaceful future, in the tradition of John Quincy Adams and Abraham Lincoln, not only is our nation doomed, but perhaps the rest of the planet as well. This is why my campaign is a national campaign, even though I'm running for U.S. Senator from New York. My friend Jose Vega will be making an important announcement soon, and will also be speaking at this event, as will Schiller Institute founder Helga Zepp-LaRouche (over video). But first, I want to thank you — so much — for supporting my campaign. I'm fighting every single day to earn your support and deliver on the promises I've made to you. From certifying the Equal Rights Amendment so that we can restore reproductive rights nationwide to fighting gun violence and keeping our communities safe, I'm working tirelessly to win change for your family. As my grandmother taught me when I was a young girl, politics isn't about parties or polling numbers. It's about the people. It's my job to serve your family and do everything that I can to make life better for you. And it's an honor that I'm grateful for every day. So thank you for trusting me with your support and giving me this incredible opportunity to serve. I wish that I could end this email here. But unfortunately, elections are an unavoidable part of politics. And to continue to serve your family in the Senate and win progress on all the issues you care about — reproductive rights, affordable health care, protecting our seniors and so much more — I need your help. Democrats are heading into a historically difficult election cycle. And here in New York, right-wing extremists just had their best election in decades in 2022. Friend,

I never thought I'd have running water, let alone be running for Congress.

My name is Mazi Melesa Pilip, but you can call me Mazi for short!

I'm the Republican nominee running in the New York special election that was just declared.

If you don't already know- this is the one & only seat we absolutely have to win to defend the House Majority.

I'm a black, Jewish woman & I'm not afraid to tell you that I am 100% Pro-Law Enforcement, Pro-Border security, and Pro-Family.

Democrats & the liberal media have spent years saying the GOP will never support someone of my ethnicity & my creed.

They say women like me don't exist & that we can't be any of those things.

And now they're spending millions to bury me in negative headlines, hit pieces, and TV commercials.

on hand. (Last cycle, the PAC spent $26.1 million.) And over the whole
year, AIPAC PAC brought in $18 million. That was up from $14.5 million in
2022.

As you know, AIPAC and their Super PAC, UDP, are planning to spend $100
million to defeat the Squad this election cycle. The donors bankrolling
these groups are the same donors who fund Donald Trump, Nikki Haley, and
other right-wing candidates and causes.

Tonight at midnight is our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we need
as much grassroots resources as possible to go up against right-wing
groups like AIPAC and their super PACs who want to take the Squad down in
2024.

January goal and have what it takes to stop AIPAC and re-elect the Squad
this year →

this is a difficult time.

** I’ll be honest with you - I’m beginning to get very concerned that the financial support I’m going to need to win this race against Democrat Jon Tester isn’t going to materialize. **

_**To say that this has been a brutal week is an understatement.**_

**First,** my opponent announced that he broke another Montana fundraising record for the 4th quarter of a non-election year, bringing in **5.5 MILLION DOLLARS** from October 31st through December 31st.

**Then** , a super PAC aligned with Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats announced they plan to spend more than _**27 MILLION DOLLARS**_ on attack ads to tank my reputation and defeat me.

**But it gets worse.**

On Monday, I sent a text message detailing how we’d been outraised by my opponent by more than 2 million dollars. I thought folks would step up and make generous contributions to my campaign when they found out how far behind my opponent we’re pacing.

**I was wrong.**

If you’re still reading this email, I hope you’re beginning to understand how frustrated I am. Then, I hope you’ll consider making a generous, immediate **[donation to my U.S. Senate campaign](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=7b00517051ae4db5937ba29e35918b92&_e=dtRFaI3VEDXcNnIS-HfMkKelySUICD75xT0S8mv6Dw93sGaHfWp7Wmk0ZWzrPGVUhKfW5YVa3Bk5zZ-ibXZyBBQJj15NTWVOSQRBk-euUk1VVWqeEytQoVY81qdpwVWKGqqCKokff6C4Ro-A4Vza2zoneW-pklXJLTM7xZDIU2158Y8NiWCaOlQINyG0Qiwc1uMFbq1xR5cXawMZeBz8eR8aHI56vt8eBHN8CVlFQfra57LZV19_zKuxjMY7a7H45zuANMGBUKHSjfghYyb21stVOttPKrvA3y58mzjmjS9xrEbuuhBS6wkJNPGnUrelMb68HzyoZTj9PgAycO4kPIlqZFPk2_xcdNGPG5kLEgfwY1-masIvno8PNMo-jTLWmJMyslxHCHDN7zD34A07QQ%3D%3D)**.

[**HELP TIM CLOSE THE GAP ->** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=7b00517051ae4db5937ba29e35918b92&_e=dtRFaI3VEDXcNnIS-HfMkKelySUICD75xT0S8mv6Dw93sGaHfWp7Wmk0ZWzrPGVUhKfW5YVa3Bk5zZ-ibXZyBBQJj15NTWVOSQRBk-euUk1VVWqeEytQoVY81qdpwVWKGqqCKokff6C4Ro-A4Vza2zoneW-pklXJLTM7xZDIU2158Y8NiWCaOlQINyG0Qiwc1uMFbq1xR5cXawMZeBz8eR8aHI56vt8eBHN8CVlFQfra57LZV19_zKuxjMY7a7H4YNKHGeo5yaI-j0crSG6PMocdDoQ0UkWW0BZixZtDVQN6bnwz6lo6EgIY3i1Mk4j9Syw23iOZxKBTkUaGEKgsAGPa8lTN2088ubm3oA68PNsorXPpWqxourBQc3R0byR1fyFcC2JQxYWYq7bjMZwCNw%3D%3D)

Never in my wildest dreams would I have thought I’d struggle this much, especially when we have such a clear path to victory.

When you run for office at almost any level, no one person, not even the best candidate you could possibly imagine, can win without the help of people who care — about their community and their country.
Those people will never give a floor speech, they'll never cast a vote in the Senate, they'll never get to talk on cable news about an important issue... but put in the hard sweat anyway.
Think about it. When someone gives $3 to a campaign, they aren't doing it to get famous, or because it will result in a tax break or government contract for their multi-billion dollar corporation.
They're doing it because they want to ensure people in this country have access to health care, well-paying jobs, and a climate that is habitable for future generations.
If everyone getting this email contributed $3, we'd meet our January fundraising goals and be well on the way toward winning this race.

name: Kelly Hall (iPhone)
subject: Just a few hours left…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Fairness Project
body:
Hi team,

Sorry for the late email — we’re closing in on our very first deadline of 2024, and it’s critical that we come out of the gate swinging.

This is no joke: 2024 is set to be one of the most pivotal elections of our lifetime, and a big part of ensuring that we continue to make the change our communities want to see is through ballot measures.

Not only are ballot measures a cornerstone of American democracy, they are one of the most democratic tools our nation has to offer. In the face of partisan gridlock, we’ve been able to use ballot measures to enact progress for over 18 million working people across the country.

But as of late, extremist legislators have started to attack direct democracy — introducing legislation that would make it harder to pass important measures at the ballot box.

This November, we’re poised to see dozens of attempts by extremist officials to restrict your voting rights. We need to make sure we have the necessary resources to fight back against these attacks.

Finishing out this first month strong is one surefire way to fuel our fight to preserve our democracy. If you’re with us, will you chip in whatever you can afford before midnight tonight to help us power-up our fight in 2024?
Here’s the link to give: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/TFPUS-ALL-Email-Jan2024-FR-January?refcode=E6822-20240131-EOM2-SL-DeadlineEOM&amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/TFPUS-ALL-Email-Jan2024-FR-January?refcode=E6822-20240131-EOM2-SL-DeadlineEOM&amount=25]

Thanks for all that you do,

Kelly Hall

Congress must reject the cruel and failed immigration policies of the last administration. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/ZsYp6Jc2ATNP3MkVzvte6Pmk0F4jS6NOytihmYTOZ1f-yWw6Cj7G9e1dlkX4TL0NMWtZ9DST5cFtdsPS-4D2fKNVbxdzSbLD9T9x2URiTkAkvV0OpQQCoNHFnrXrpjTvq8JkQOtBrkHl1-fSGes0Er7h6XT2ezVaXkzyJO4CIThntNF706_JRJvpu0b5lgqpA2VYXBDLSqQY_c1NC9lSMWkbMy7F3fvTz7DRdi-oX71-vqbT8G6IBrBGeGuLvyQrSdIZRIOlMpghWw3sg3Fr5tvBQQV-3IXbXeoKpu8gJjaUDp_Uj3EPbgubzh-vAUvn/43g/fCfDkZIlQoyj5QgAtCBPeg/h0/IIt3Y0crz89M2HKhrTswgdADyVqg2tTGIGk9-9dYcfg)
---
Friend, Congressional negotiators are nearing an agreement on an immigration policy package that includes billions of dollars to the Israeli military and the reimplementation of devastating Trump-era border measures. In addition to funding and enabling the Israeli government’s genocide against the Palestinian people, this bill would end or drastically restrict asylum protections for immigrants seeking safety in the United States, fast track deportation, and increase family detention in cages. As a former immigration attorney, I know immigrants who have been waiting between 10 to 20 years to unite with family members. I see how these negotiations are yet another example of how both Democrats and Republicans are failing our immigrant neighbors. The continued approach of “prisons first, humanity later” demonizes and dehumanizes migrants who are trying to keep their families together. [**Add your name now to demand Congress reject any immigration package that sends our tax dollars to the Israeli military or harms immigrant communities in the United States.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnnYY4qGNyrBp9XdLcdejX6QUopabgGO4vyEAWazUJmI0kaaljR5zTuZ6xFQCjviJGgQYHhYhQGgs5wXC8EP7RcCu1js7iq9Ugm4-F08BkPMCYViV47OnBt90LHeVsTm8Pb7CC9BzMqzmgK3oE4EnCq3otD2XIg8O6y4ee1IQzSsr4gat9ybet_dnjgKtNm71Q473Tp20K72gXYejncRUiS6UE60-XtGtNSNJOe5vK-6d5WKRTumSx1kYGjCiVuXKgBIG1zJMreXXU4KL9UW3p-qZm_jJ3N-cnO4kSApE_nnXvIwhruoGrp1x6j6LWvpPIIKJvSJ2-0evvSLnn83JUvk/43g/fCfDkZIlQoyj5QgAtCBPeg/h1/t-rgeHMyK3Tssfc5YHLDvu-RKZXhDyj6avjtjSo_p1M) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnnYY4qGNyrBp9XdLcdejX6QUopabgGO4vyEAWazUJmI0kaaljR5zTuZ6xFQCjviJGhJQAg-bN0ACaIZEQpycCyT1_DEegJcLfUHK7furH4VrRxOtMWe4SHT48yUjaBy4hPpL6lDf7OznRAZyjaZCPuy4PhmT2kT9-CTwqHBezVP8jzO_5-iVgYuzzo3DB196ENq0ji6SbkvFwrvFy19pG7KGDNTRgAcRdG3AOwSinqqtuZz50MLfYOoEuuQ_RduCOqKiy7y1PzxbTEu7rI45a2xEfG6TBLfOrR23aIJllH4w-dFzNPk02d85P8dxx7fdCVOKWnGyxh5brj5dLX_J_x5/43g/fCfDkZIlQoyj5QgAtCBPeg/h2/j3f_aApv_4vytlbnshmjNFJSK40ZJdZBSAxNxmltgnM)
---
Instead of reviving the cruel and failed immigration policies of the last administration, Congress should instead:
* **Increase Funding for the Shelter and Services Program (SSP)** , the new grant-making body that supports cities, localities, and non-governmental organizations assisting newly arrived migrants. These funds are often described as a “lifeline” for people recently released from Department of Homeland Security (DHS) custody, supporting them with food, clothing, basic medical aid, legal information, and transportation needs.

* **Sufficiently fund the Office of Field Operations:** It’s essential OFO receives increased funding to screen and process people as they arrive at the border to seek asylum and other forms of protection.

* **Increase funding for Employment Authorization and Other Application Processing, Backlog Reduction, and Integration Funding:** The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) is the agency responsible for employment authorization and houses the Asylum Corps, who conduct asylum interview screenings and adjudications.

* **Increase Funding for Legal Representation, Child Advocates and Post-Release Services for Unaccompanied Children:** Funds for legal representation must be increased because unaccompanied toddlers and children continue to appear in U.S. immigration courts without a lawyer.

* **Create and expand legal pathways to citizenship, including work permits and labor protections,** so the millions of migrants who are already our neighbors can stay here and thrive here.

[**Add your name to tell Congress to reject any immigration policies that send taxpayer dollars to the Israeli military or to harm vulnerable immigrant communities.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnnYY4qGNyrBp9XdLcdejX6QUopabgGO4vyEAWazUJmI0kaaljR5zTuZ6xFQCjviJGgQR6uBeCrHYFH458Hpp8rNs7ek8Yd_edyLriY3XAuIkAFt9bmvvUFzkLngwqYtiRLxHsbfLjUNVE3aS3dcGL0H2N4UlmflyE9WyJDBdpjUpcdAooOkipB7aCDmh3CwpqeeMUc6vq6_4FyLAha6xrkiGj_vIopRgE3JYSOlVY-m6NOnQ_IDF9OtvhJdZdNhbdzRXRIAIiDeNJ4DNjAMcSEI7GBinHxeETlw4zxcRAJ8-fjSxfP1dibJlNYHsxEuc9GdCPiUpZLYgH-tEpLykECk/43g/fCfDkZIlQoyj5QgAtCBPeg/h3/YbO8zZNW9Ei248hid7lu_SXluRCcKW5F3jxzLEQ0zps)
“Tough on immigration” rhetoric from both parties―including presidents of both parties―hasn’t done anything to fix our broken immigration system. Both parties have engaged in fear mongering and have proposed policies rooted in racism and xenophobia. We must not vilify or lock up people who are simply trying to seek a better life.
Thank you for fighting for the humanity of marginalized communities.
In solidarity,
Rashida

clean_body: Congress must reject the cruel and failed immigration policies of the last administration. | | | Friend, Congressional negotiators are nearing an agreement on an immigration policy package that includes billions of dollars to the Israeli military and the reimplementation of devastating Trump-era border measures. In addition to funding and enabling the Israeli government’s genocide against the Palestinian people, this bill would end or drastically restrict asylum protections for immigrants seeking safety in the United States, fast track deportation, and increase family detention in cages. As a former immigration attorney, I know immigrants who have been waiting between 10 to 20 years to unite with family members. I see how these negotiations are yet another example of how both Democrats and Republicans are failing our immigrant neighbors. The continued approach of “prisons first, humanity later” demonizes and dehumanizes migrants who are trying to keep their families together. | Instead of reviving the cruel and failed immigration policies of the last administration, Congress should instead: Increase Funding for the Shelter and Services Program (SSP) , the new grant-making body that supports cities, localities, and non-governmental organizations assisting newly arrived migrants. These funds are often described as a “lifeline” for people recently released from Department of Homeland Security (DHS) custody, supporting them with food, clothing, basic medical aid, legal information, and transportation needs. Sufficiently fund the Office of Field Operations: It’s essential OFO receives increased funding to screen and process people as they arrive at the border to seek asylum and other forms of protection. Increase funding for Employment Authorization and Other Application Processing, Backlog Reduction, and Integration Funding: The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) is the agency responsible for employment authorization and houses the Asylum Corps, who conduct asylum interview screenings and adjudications. Increase Funding for Legal Representation, Child Advocates and Post-Release Services for Unaccompanied Children: Funds for legal representation must be increased because unaccompanied toddlers and children continue to appear in U.S. immigration courts without a lawyer. Create and expand legal pathways to citizenship, including work permits and labor protections, so the millions of migrants who are already our neighbors can stay here and thrive here. “Tough on immigration” rhetoric from both parties―including presidents of both parties―hasn’t done anything to fix our broken immigration system. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

I began my education at Our Lady of Fatima, where I learned the values I hold today. I am the devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned, no matter where my life has taken me. My husband Pat and I cherish our home in New Mexico, that we have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like my father and mother, I have been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those whom quality healthcare was out of reach. I have also been a champion of improving the education of our youth in underserved communities.

Like everyone starting their career, I began at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I helped build businesses, helped companies grow, and created jobs. With this business experience, I will help New Mexico attract new companies and create jobs - so hardworking New Mexicans can find success and live their American Dream.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity and rich traditions, hardworking people, and leading national laboratories. But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us. The cost of living is up, we are in a crime crisis, the border is wide open, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.

We are clearly on the wrong track. We can and must do better. That’s why I am running for the United States Senate.” _-Nella_**

body:
Colin Allred just announced a MASSIVE $15 million fundraising haul, and he is within two points of our campaign in the polls.
Fellow American - This is a crisis.

The election year could not have gotten started on a more concerning note. Colin Allred, challenging me for the U.S. Senate, raised $15 million last quarter. That is a considerable number and only part of what he’s raised. All the dark money groups in D.C. are chomping at the bit to cut massive checks to my Democrat opponent.

Here’s the bad news: **_all the money flooding Texas is working._**

**But it’s not just Texans that should be concerned.** We are fighting to take back the Majority, and we need to HOLD this seat to make that dream a reality! If we lose this seat, it would be a disaster for our plans to take back the Majority.

Your gift will directly fund our strategy to WIN in November.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=678fbb2086934daca30a7892b85b31dc&_e=t1GGWGkexrENybIGx0cz50JUXyJ3Jk_InzCP3EVP3J8qVoqnBTBuqbNlKFiVt-dD1dWjAtHnilGMLnnf67BJI4PBCaIw5dsWJmA-jz5aT5poM88lXgVGhlaUnEs070ATjwilv2U_Qpr8K08mNYSNULmTZ0jVMTOlrXeGlp43h9_jIZY5XJEdE3j6UXEKu2_g-N8mubny1_jL7lW79kVNWUBfillpPWDqIQefJO7_18CCVDbDYTo8dAq6WIarsvWQUAjHk3EyUESwHwGEMEpN7HtdwceFPXSZzZHatJ1zRGUi13RbnEakenADje31lQ1ZSiCxmpc_V-p9FJ7n0G45IT5wbx8q6x5iLstzQxEOaunMG-Z4lT5hC2-_tnIjOSVyl_KUhHdGisrnV5e20Zep0dIizbTzWEkeiaIXPDa61yw%3D)

[**WATCH MY FOX NEWS INTERVIEW**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=678fbb2086934daca30a7892b85b31dc&_e=t1GGWGkexrENybIGx0cz50JUXyJ3Jk_InzCP3EVP3J8qVoqnBTBuqbNlKFiVt-dD1dWjAtHnilGMLnnf67BJI4PBCaIw5dsWJmA-jz5aT5poM88lXgVGhlaUnEs070ATjwilv2U_Qpr8K08mNYSNULmTZ0jVMTOlrXeGlp43h9_jIZY5XJEdE3j6UXEKu2_g-N8mubny1_jL7lW79kVNWUBfillpPWDqIQefJO7_18CCVDbDYTo8dAq6WIarsvWQUAjHk3EyUESwHwGEMEpN7JnIdstMDdyPiQYZIDuNxCodwS1qm6v6bls12o3ButwDnCxHzVRGvUvR7YpBlBWl-Q7qYoV6etS8ZoeY9bTf1dL8nV__7Tt_TYHwEIgbvkSge90876beiU-azMQe72ErOyPXfPjKwfqlNLToKPWGBOk%3D)
This race is going to be a hard-fought battle to the finish. Pundits and politicians will try to predict who is in the lead, and pollsters will charge money to tell us more of what we already know: it will come down to the wire.

We can’t fall behind in the fundraising race this early. That would mean disaster for our campaign come this fall. Collin Allred will flood the airwaves with his message that I am wrong for Texas, and he is our future. He will attack my family and my values and tear down my record of accomplishment in the U.S. Senate.

But we will win if we fight back, spreading the truth to voters about my family, voting record, and principled beliefs. But that will get very expensive. Advertisements are always costly, but as the election grows nearer, the TV and radio stations hike their rates WAY up.

And that is precisely when we will NEED to be up on the air spreading our positive message and countering sneaky attacks from Allred and his D.C. dark money allies. So we’ve got to have our fundraising to strike back hard and fast and spread the truth.

[**That’s why I’m asking for your most generous contribution to my re-election campaign today.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=678fbb2086934daca30a7892b85b31dc&_e=t1GGWGkexrENybIGx0cz50JUXyJ3Jk_InzCP3EVP3J8qVoqnBTBuqbNlKFiVt-dD1dWjAtHnilGMLnnf67BJI4PBCaIw5dsWJmA-jz5aT5poM88lXgVGhlaUnEs070ATjwilv2U_Qpr8K08mNYSNULmTZ0jVMTOlrXeGlp43h9_jIZY5XJEdE3j6UXEKu2_g-N8mubny1_jL7lW79kVNWUBfillpPWDqIQefJO7_18CCVDbDYTo8dAq6WIarsvWQUAjHk3EyUESwHwGEMEpN7G93TAhfG1oLjQJVQbtLGCAPv4yZXW0y-6S22EDt-hN8FPwiJFGbO8qB0SEnW2gpiDWiUAPdNl8Dckc_coP8xsDUzh-_GoMMC1uQUwS_VowOAU7_dRnUuSnjgi2AnXt1YX97A3Qy8uWTJnqlLNWCnLA%3D) _We will win this thing if we keep our foot on the gas._

I appreciate your support,

Ted Cruz

Brandon Herrera

And in order to show my gratitude, I'll be offering another one of my favorite personal firearms as an extra incentive: a beautiful AKG Built Tantal AK-47 in 5.45 (see the photo below). Every $5 you donate will earn you one entry to win; $20 gets you 4 entries, $100 gets you 20 entries, etc. Can you help me out by chipping in a contribution at ? I'm running in the largest border district in the country, and there is a lot of ground to cover. Your support will help me spread the message about my campaign to Republican primary voters. Please make a donation today at . I 'll give one lucky donor my AKG Built Tantal AK-47 in 5.45. Every $5 you contribute will earn you an entry. I've already given away one rifle and one trip to a range day in San Antonio, and I can't wait to notify the next winner. Thanks for all your help. clean_body: Time sensitive | | | | | Friend, You and I both know that we have a big year ahead of us. Between now and Election Day, there is going to be a lot happening. There will be times when our campaign will have to play tough defense against the Radical Democrats’ full-blown assault against us (which has already started), and there will be important times when we MUST be on offense. This particular email is about the latter. Tonight is our campaign’s FIRST fundraising deadline of the year, and it will absolutely set the tone for the rest of this race. | | | | My team and I have been racing against the clock to hit our goal. Every time I have called on you in the past, you have stepped up - and I am asking you to do it again. Your past support helped us to be one of five Republicans to defeat an extreme incumbent Democrat in 2022. What happens tonight could very easily make or break our re-election. I know it sounds like an exaggeration, but it could not be more true. | | | | , every single contribution takes us one step closer to hitting our goal and starting our re-election year off on the right foot. I appreciate your support here more than you know.
